teacher_info.about_teacher:
【熟能生巧】【Practice Makes Perfect】【習うより慣れよ】【배우기보다 익숙해져라】

从学生时代，我已经开始教来自不同文化的学生。，而且我在中国、日本、印度尼西亚和韩国都教过。 我不仅在italki, Duolingo多邻国, Tutoring等线上平台有教学经历，在很多线下平台也积累了多年的丰富经验。

Since school years, I have already started to teach foreign students from different cultures. For offline, I have been teaching in China, Japan, Indonesia, and Korea. For online, I have been teaching on different platforms, such as italki, Duolingo, Tutoring and quite a few local brands.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
【熟能生巧】【Practice Makes Perfect】【習うより慣れよ】【배우기보다 익숙해져라】

From the correction of pronunciation to the free conversation, the free communication with the topic of interest. For language learning, the most basic thing is the correction of pronunciation, a good foundation will double the effort. Learning languages require the accumulation of words and patterns. It is important to memorize the expressions you have seen and learned as much as possible so that you can use them flexibly in different contexts. A word or pattern could not be well used until practiced more than 7 times. Look forward to meeting you in class.

exp_info.description: Multicultural atmosphere that requires communicating with each other through multiple languages. Understand clients' needs and help them to achieve their goals. In a sense, a consultant and a teacher are the same role.
Help students to pass the HSK exams and achieve the dream of fluent communication

Provide one-on-one immersive instruction to learners from all over the world who want to learn Chinese and other languages. This experience has taught me a lot about how to meet students at their specific needs and tailor lessons based on what students find most difficult and what students could use the best practice on.

Organized different language exchange events and classes (Mandarin Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean) for language learners around the world. I have learned a lot of experience on how to effectively and interestingly organize language exchange events and classes for groups of students.

Work as a communitive leader there to organized different language exchange events and classes (Mandarin Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean) for language learners around the world. Love all my students there and appreciate that compare with other online platforms, I have got a different experience on how to effectively and interestingly organize language exchange events and classes for groups of students.

K-pop is getting more attention and become more and more popular not just in east Asia. Help to organize different K-pop events and help to interpret between K-pop singers, actors, actress and their fans from every corner of the world. I have a strong interest in both K-pop concert, fan meetings and multicultural environment. During the work, I learned a lot on how to help the fans who have difficulties on communication in a different language they could not speak and understand.

pro_course_detail.title: 【For new student】 Interesting structured TEXTBOOK class with tons of fun (A1~B1) / 轻松有趣的基础课本教程/ 个人定制课程 (TOPIK1~ TOPIK3) / 興味深いテキストレッスン(TOPIK1~ TOPIK3)
pro_course_detail.description:
1. What kind of course is it ? 
It's very structured classes using text book. 

2. What books do we use? 

1)	"Yonsei University Korean" or  ”Vitamin Korean“ Course
The most students like "Yonsei University Korean" or  ”Vitamin Korean“ series.
They have 6 books by levels and you can improve your Korean level very balanced 
and there are many exercise in it.
Each book takes about 15hours to finish and you can talk in Korean when you finish 1st book. 

2)	”Korean Grammar in Use“ or your favorite textbook 
One of the most popular Textbook.
We will make many sentences and I will correct them checking what we use frequently use in our life and what we don’t.
There are 3 books in series (beginner, intermediate, advanced) 
You will be able to make simple conversation after learning half of the beginner book, and will understand almost all of daily Korean grammar when you finish intermediate one.
 
3）《延世韩国语》《活学活用韩语语法》或者 你喜欢的教材 （for Chinese speakers）
《延世韩国语》是韩语学习界非常经典的一套教材，分六个等级，精准对应TOPIK考试的6个级别。学完1级就可以进行简单的交流，学完3级基本就可以应对大部分的日常会话。4级以上开始比较侧重高级的书面表达。
《活学活用韩语语法》是韩语语法界的宝典级语法书，简洁明了，足够的例子和练习，是不可多得的语法界绝绝子的存在。

4）「延世韓国語」あるいは お好きなテキスト （for Japanese speakers）
《延世韩国语》は、韓国語学習の定番テキストで、TOPIK試験の6つのレベルにぴったりと対応した6段階のレベルに分かれています。 レベル1以降は簡単なコミュニケーションができるようになり、レベル3以降はほとんどの日常会話に対応できるようになり、レベル4以降は高度な文章表現に焦点が当てられるようになります。


3. Home work?
I will give you Homework with exercises in the book, and other things if you want more.

4. How often do you recommend to have classes?
I highly recommend you to have 2 classes a week, you can buy 5 or 10 classes package, it's cheaper and will make you motivated 💪💪




In our first class, we are going to decide what book we use. I am sure, you will like your books

Thank you very much~ , See you in our class! ^^

《延世韩国语》是韩语学习界非常经典的一套教材，分六个等级，精准对应TOPIK考试的6个级别。学完1级就可以进行简单的交流，学完3级基本就可以应对大部分的日常会话。4级以上开始比较侧重高级的书面表达。
《活学活用韩语语法》是韩语语法界的宝典级语法书，简洁明了，足够的例子和练习，是不可多得的语法界绝绝子的存在。

4）「延世韓国語」あるいは お好きなテキスト （for Japanese speakers）
《延世韩国语》は、韓国語学習の定番テキストで、TOPIK試験の6つのレベルにぴったりと対応した6段階のレベルに分かれています。 レベル1以降は簡単なコミュニケーションができるようになり、レベル3以降はほとんどの日常会話に対応できるようになり、レベル4以降は高度な文章表現に焦点が当てられるようになります。

I highly recommend you to have 2 classes a week, you can buy 5 or 10 classes package, it's cheaper and will make you motivated 💪💪

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
The objective for each lesson:
1. To learn about the alphabet plus names
2. To learn about numbers 
3.. To learn the articles a, an, and the.
4. To learn English introductions and farewells
5. To learn about people, places, and nationalities and the questions who, what, and where

Teaching method:
I incorporate different kinds of teaching methods in class depending on the needs of the students. These teaching methods are: 
a. direct method - I use this when a student makes a mistake which I immediately correct and praises him/her when she/he makes a correct answer.
b. communicative language teaching - I use this method to enhance the student's ability to speak English by using real-life contexts like making requests, accepting offers, explaining things, and expressing their feelings and preferences.
c. Total Physical Response - I only use this method when needed especially when a student is struggling in understanding a word or a context.

pro_course_detail.title: CONꓦERSATIONAL ENGLISH CLASS ( SINGLE LESSON)
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the "Conversational English Class (Single Lesson)"! In this engaging and interactive session, you can expect to improve your English language skills through practical exercises and real-life conversation scenarios.

Objective: The primary objective of this class is to enhance your conversational skills in English. Whether you are a beginner looking to build confidence in speaking or an intermediate/advanced learner seeking to refine your language proficiency, this class caters to all levels.

CLASS STRUCTURE:
Icebreaker: The class will kick off with a friendly icebreaker activity. This will help you feel comfortable, creating a relaxed environment for effective learning.

Vocabulary Enhancement: You will be introduced to new vocabulary related to various topics such as travel, food, hobbies, or current events. The instructor will provide explanations and examples, and you will get a chance to practice using the words in context.

This approach allows you to practice real-life scenarios, such as ordering food at a restaurant, asking for directions, or making small talk with strangers. The instructor will guide you and provide constructive feedback to improve your language skills.

Error Correction: Mistakes are a natural part of learning, and this class is a safe space to make them. The instructor will provide gentle corrections and tips to help you avoid common errors and reinforce proper language usage.

Cultural Insights: Cultural Insights: Language and culture go hand in hand. You will gain insights into English-speaking cultures, customs, and social norms. This knowledge will aid you in understanding the context behind certain expressions and enhance your overall language proficiency.              

BENEFITS: 
Improved fluency: Regular practice in conversational settings will boost your confidence and fluency in English.

teacher_info.teaching_style: I aim to teach and share three languages: English, Tagalog, and Cebuano. pro_course_detail.title: English Conversational Lesson (Speaking class)
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson focuses on improving your English speaking confidence through natural conversation.

It is perfect for beginner and intermediate learners who want to practice speaking English in a relaxed and supportive environment.

During the lesson we will:
• Practice everyday English conversations
• Learn useful vocabulary and expressions
• Improve pronunciation and fluency
• Correct mistakes and give helpful feedback

Topics may include daily life, travel, work, hobbies, culture, and many more.

My goal is to help you speak English comfortably and confidently.

pro_course_detail.title: English Pronunciation Lesson (Beginner–Intermediate)
pro_course_detail.description:
Improve your English pronunciation and speak more clearly and confidently. This lesson focuses on helping students pronounce common English sounds correctly, including TH, SH, CH, R, L, and vowel sounds.

Students will practice word stress, sentence rhythm, and natural speaking patterns through guided exercises, repetition, and speaking practice. The teacher provides immediate correction and feedback to help students quickly improve their pronunciation.

This class is ideal for beginner and intermediate learners who want to speak English more clearly, reduce pronunciation mistakes, and build confidence in conversation.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English Language for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for students who are just starting to learn English or who want to build a strong foundation. In this course, we focus on simple vocabulary, basic grammar, and everyday conversations that you can use in real life.

Students will learn how to introduce themselves, ask and answer simple questions, talk about daily activities, and understand common English expressions. We will also practice pronunciation, listening, and speaking to help you communicate more clearly and confidently.

The goal of this class is to help you feel comfortable using basic English in everyday situations. Mistakes are welcome. This is a supportive space to learn and improve step by step.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English Language for Intermediate learners
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for students who already know basic English but want to improve their fluency and confidence. In this course, we focus on expanding vocabulary, improving grammar, and practicing more natural conversations.

Students will learn how to express opinions, describe experiences, and talk about past, present, and future events more clearly. We will also practice pronunciation, sentence structure, and listening skills to help you communicate more naturally.

In addition, we will explore how to use punctuation correctly, understand common slang, and learn useful idioms that native speakers use in everyday conversations.

The goal of this class is to help you speak English more smoothly, understand others better, and communicate with greater confidence in real-life situations.

pro_course_detail.title: ENGLISH FOR EXAMS (IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, CAMBRIDGE)
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to help students build the skills and confidence needed to succeed in major English proficiency exams such as IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, and Cambridge tests. Suitable for learners aged 9 and above, lessons focus on improving reading, writing, listening, and speaking through structured practice and exam-style tasks.

Students will learn effective test strategies, time management, vocabulary building, grammar accuracy, and clear communication. Each lesson is interactive and tailored to the student’s level, helping them understand exam formats and perform better under test conditions.

By the end of the course, students will feel more confident, prepared, and equipped to achieve higher scores in their exams.

pro_course_detail.title: 1- Conversations Dynamiques : Corrections et Retours Personnalisés  // Dynamic Conversations: Personalized Corrections and Feedback
pro_course_detail.description:
Français :
Découvrez nos cours de conversation, une excellente opportunité pour pratiquer le français tout en développant votre écoute et votre compréhension. Lors de ces leçons, nous aborderons des sujets qui vous passionnent, ainsi que des thèmes d'actualité captivants. Après notre première leçon, je reste disponible 24h/24 et 7j/7 pour répondre à toutes vos questions concernant nos cours ou la langue française. Ensemble, nous travaillerons à rendre votre apprentissage enrichissant et agréable, tout en vous aidant à gagner en confiance à l’oral.

English:
Join our conversation classes, a fantastic opportunity to practice French while enhancing your listening and comprehension skills. During these lessons, we will explore topics that excite you, along with engaging current events. While the focus is on conversation, I will be happy to explain any grammar or conjugation points as needed. Naturally curious, I have a broad range of interests, so please feel free to share your preferred topics!

After our first lesson, I remain available 24/7 to answer any questions related to our lessons or the French language. Together, we will work to make your learning experience enriching and enjoyable while helping you build confidence in your speaking skills.

Français

Le cours d'essai est l'occasion de faire un petit bilan sur vos besoins et attentes en matière de français afin de vous accompagner de la meilleure manière dans votre apprentissage. Nous pourrons pratiquer la conversation, des tests de niveaux et échanger sur les points importants pour progresser et les méthodes pour apprendre rapidement.

English
This lesson is for those who have used up all their trial lessons but would still like to have a trial class with me before committing to future lessons.
It follows the same structure as described in my trial lesson description.

If you have already had a class with me, I will not accept your lesson request!

The trial course is an opportunity to take stock of your needs and expectations in terms of French in order to support you in the best way in your learning. We will be able to practice conversation, level tests and discuss the important points to progress and the methods to learn quickly.

pro_course_detail.title: 3- Maîtrisez l'Argot Français : Verlan, Langage Familier et Abréviations ! // Master French Slang: Verlan, Colloquial Language, and Abbreviations!
pro_course_detail.description:
Français :
Ce cours s’adresse aux apprenants ayant déjà un bon niveau de français (au moins B2) souhaitant approfondir leur compréhension des expressions courantes, du verlan et de l’argot français. Ici, nous explorerons des mots et des expressions souvent négligés dans les cours traditionnels. Vous apprendrez à comprendre et à parler en argot, en découvrant le verlan, qui consiste à inverser les syllabes d’un mot. Très utilisé dans certains milieux et particulièrement prisé par les jeunes, cet argot est essentiel pour mieux saisir la culture française.

Pour vous aider à communiquer aisément en argot, nous mènerons des conversations principalement en utilisant ces expressions. Des supports audio, PDF et vidéos enrichiront votre apprentissage et testeront votre compréhension orale. Nous aborderons les mots et expressions en verlan par thème, dans une ambiance conviviale et amusante. Apprendre l’argot peut être ludique et divertissant, alors préparez-vous à vous exprimer avec style !

English:
This course is designed for learners who already have a good level of French (at least B2) and wish to enhance their understanding of common expressions, French slang, and Verlan. We will explore words and expressions often overlooked in traditional lessons. You’ll learn to understand and speak in slang, discovering Verlan, which involves inverting the syllables of a word. Widely used in certain circles and popular among young people, this slang is essential for grasping French culture.

To help you communicate easily in slang, we will engage in conversations primarily using these expressions. Audio, PDF, and video resources will enrich your learning experience and test your oral comprehension. We will approach slang expressions and words thematically, all while maintaining a fun and friendly atmosphere. Learning slang can be playful and enjoyable, so get ready to express yourself with flair!

pro_course_detail.title: 4- NEWWWW!!!! Accompagnement aux examens de français (FLE)  //  French Exam Preparation (FLE)
pro_course_detail.description:
Français :
Je vous propose une préparation personnalisée aux principaux examens de français : DELF A1–B2, DALF C1–C2, TCF (Canada, Québec), TEF, tests scolaires et universitaires.
Ma méthode repose sur un diagnostic précis, un entraînement ciblé et des stratégies pour chaque épreuve : compréhension orale et écrite, expression écrite, expression orale avec simulations d’examen, gestion du temps et correction des erreurs fréquentes.
Chaque séance est conçue pour renforcer votre confiance, améliorer vos compétences et vous guider vers une réussite sereine. L’ambiance est bienveillante, motivante et structurée, avec des supports authentiques et des retours détaillés pour progresser rapidement.

English :
I offer personalized coaching for major French exams: DELF A1–B2, DALF C1–C2, TCF (Canada, Québec), TEF, and academic tests.
My approach includes a clear initial assessment, targeted practice, and proven strategies for each exam component: listening, reading, writing, and speaking with real exam simulations. We focus on time management, structure, accuracy, and boosting your confidence.
Each lesson provides a supportive, motivating, and organized environment, with authentic materials, detailed corrections, and practical guidance to help you progress efficiently and pass your exam with confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: 5- NEWWWW!!!! Walk in Paris – Cours de français en immersion réelle / Real-life immersive French lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Français :
Apprenez le français en explorant Paris à mes côtés, directement en situation réelle ! Cette leçon se déroule en face à face, dans des lieux authentiques : parcs, cafés, musées, expositions, marchés ou quartiers emblématiques. Chaque séance est construite autour d'interactions concrètes : commander dans un café, demander une information, décrire un tableau, discuter avec des Parisiens ou gérer une situation du quotidien.
L’objectif est d’améliorer votre expression orale, votre fluidité, votre prononciation et votre confiance grâce à des échanges naturels et spontanés. Le contenu s’adapte à votre niveau et à vos besoins : conversation guidée, vocabulaire utile, révisions sur place et corrections immédiates. Je propose des formules flexibles : séance classique, immersion longue, forfait demi-journée, journée complète, ou programme sur plusieurs jours/semaines pour une immersion linguistique profonde au cœur de Paris.

English :
Learn French while discovering Paris through real-life, face-to-face sessions with me. Each lesson takes place in authentic locations such as parks, cafés, museums, exhibitions, markets or iconic neighborhoods. Every session focuses on practical interactions: ordering in a café, asking for information, describing art, handling daily situations or chatting with locals. You will boost your speaking skills, fluency, pronunciation and confidence through natural conversations in real contexts. All content is fully adapted to your goals: guided dialogues, useful vocabulary, on-the-spot corrections and cultural insights.
Flexible formats are available: standard sessions, extended immersions, half-day packages, full-day experiences, or multi-day/weekly immersion programs for learners seeking fast progress and a deeper connection to the French language and Parisian life.

pro_course_detail.title: 6- NEWWWW!!!! Parle comme un Parisien – Prononciation & Accent Parisien / Speak Like a Parisian – Pronunciation & Paris Accent Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Français :
Envie d’un français clair, élégant et naturel, comme celui que l’on entend dans les rues de Paris ? Cette leçon est spécialement conçue pour améliorer ta prononciation et t’aider à maîtriser l’accent parisien moderne. Nous travaillerons la musicalité du français, les sons complexes (é/è/eu/u), les liaisons essentielles, le rythme de la phrase et l’intonation typique parisienne, plus directe et précise. Grâce à une approche personnalisée, tu apprendras à corriger tes habitudes, à placer ta voix, à articuler avec fluidité et à rendre ton français plus naturel.
La séance inclut : exercices ciblés, répétitions guidées, écoute active, lecture optimisée et mise en situation dans une mini-conversation pour ancrer les bons réflexes.
Cette leçon est idéale si tu veux gagner en clarté, confiance et authenticité, que ce soit pour vivre à Paris, travailler en français ou simplement te sentir plus à l’aise à l’oral.

English : 
Want to sound clear, natural, and elegant—just like people speaking French in the streets of Paris? This lesson is designed to refine your pronunciation and help you master the modern Parisian accent. We’ll work on French rhythm, difficult vowel sounds (é/è/eu/u), key liaisons, smooth articulation, and the distinctive Parisian intonation, which is both direct and precise. Through a personalized approach, you’ll learn to correct your habits, position your mouth and voice correctly, and make your French sound more fluid and authentic.
The session includes targeted drills, guided repetition, active listening, optimized reading, and a short real-life conversation practice to reinforce the right pronunciation patterns.
This lesson is perfect if you want more clarity, confidence, and a natural Parisian sound—whether you’re planning to live in France, use French at work, or simply speak more comfortably.

pro_course_detail.description:

Grâce à ma maîtrise du français, je peux expliquer clairement les bases de la grammaire anglaise, les premiers pas essentiels, la prononciation et le vocabulaire du quotidien afin de vous aider à comprendre facilement et à progresser avec confiance.

Nous travaillerons ensemble les fondations importantes de l’anglais : salutations, phrases simples, verbes de base, construction des phrases, vocabulaire essentiel, compréhension orale et prononciation. Les cours sont simples, progressifs et adaptés à votre rythme pour vous permettre de construire de bonnes bases dès le début.

Les leçons sont personnalisées selon votre âge, votre niveau et vos objectifs : école, voyage, travail, conversation ou anglais du quotidien. Les débutants complets sont les bienvenus et aucun niveau préalable n’est nécessaire pour commencer.

Lessons are personalized according to your age, level, and goals: school, travel, work, conversation, or daily English. Complete beginners are very welcome, and no prior level is required to start.

teacher_info.intro:
Remember your summer vacation in 1989? 

At an amusement park, you met Barney — a local who had 
been studying English his entire life. And yet, when you asked
him what his favorite animal was, he froze. He stammered. 
He looked up at some trees. Hmmm.

The next day you went on a train ride. In your compartment
were three backpackers from places you couldn’t pronounce.

Still, they talked to you about discos...pyramids...zoology...
bungee jumping...watermelons...Batman...Mt Everest...seals...
UFOs…jujitsu...cactus...bugs...telekinesis...off-the-wall jokes . . .

“How did you master English?” you eventually asked them.
“Oh, from watching cartoons when we were young,” they answered.

              *             *             *             *             *             *             *

In class, you will NOT be asked to memorize lines such as 

“I beg your pardon. I was wondering if you could please tell me the price of a third-class, round-trip plane ticket with a student discount for a window-seat in the non-smoking section, departing from Kalamazoo at 3:13 in the morning of Thursday, the 31st of December and arriving in Saskatoon at 11:33 in the evening.” 

Or, “In order to get to the flea market, walk along this boulevard. At the eighth traffic light, you’ll see a subway station to your left. Go down and catch train number 181. After 18 stops, get off. Take the 80 bus down the avenue for eight blocks. Then turn right, walk 88 yards — and you’re there. You CAN’T miss it!"

.
SUMMER VACATION
Remember your vacation at the seaside last summer?

On your third day there, you met some locals at an
amusement park. They told you that they had been studying
English for *ten whole years*.

And yet when you asked them what their favorite animal was, 
they froze. They stammered. They became dumbstruck.

Now, why was that?

Hmmm. Good question.

Indeed, virtually nobody, locals and tourists alike, could
speak any English at all.

THE TRAIN RIDE
At the end of your stay, you decided to return by train. In
your compartment were some travelers who introduced
themselves as being from Kyrgyzstan and Tierra del Fuego . . .
. . . you all had a long, fascinating conversation.

And they spoke *flawless* English.

So what was their secret?

"Oh, I just picked it up," they reply casually.

(In other words they had PRACTICED their English.
 Extensively. Just like in sports).

Righto.

pro_course_detail.title: Daily English Free talking
pro_course_detail.description:
To enhance your speaking ability with the help of Daily activity topics.

Here's a more detailed breakdown:
1. Active Listening:
Pay close attention: Focus on what the other person is saying, both verbally and nonverbally. 
Show you're listening: Nod, make eye contact, and use verbal cues like "uh-huh" or "I see". 
Ask clarifying questions: Demonstrate you're engaged by asking questions to understand their perspective. 
Reflect and paraphrase: Summarize what you've heard to ensure understanding and show you're paying attention. 
2. Engaging Questions:
Ask open-ended questions: Encourage detailed responses instead of just "yes" or "no" answers. 
Follow up on answers: Show genuine interest by asking more questions based on their responses. 
Find common ground: Look for shared interests or experiences to build rapport and keep the conversation flowing. 
Avoid leading questions: Don't steer the conversation towards your own opinions or experiences. 
3. Body Language and Tone:
Maintain eye contact: It shows you're engaged and interested in the conversation. 
Use open body language: Avoid crossing your arms or looking down, as these can signal disinterest. 
Speak clearly and at a comfortable pace: Avoid mumbling or speaking too quickly, which can make it difficult to follow. 
Be mindful of your tone: A positive and friendly tone can make conversations more enjoyable.

pro_course_detail.title: A1 to A2 speaking practice and grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
Speaking Practice
Basic Conversations: Engage in simple dialogues about familiar topics such as daily activities, personal information, and hobbies.
Asking and Answering Questions: Practice asking for and giving directions, making purchases, and ordering food in a restaurant.
Describing: Learn to describe your surroundings, family, and friends with more detail.
Expressing Preferences: Talk about your likes, dislikes, and preferences.
Role-Playing: Simulate real-life situations such as visiting the doctor, making travel arrangements, or shopping.
Improving Pronunciation: Focus on clear pronunciation and intonation to be better understood.
Using Common Expressions: Use everyday expressions and phrases to sound more natural.
Grammar
Sentence Structure: Understand and use basic sentence structures with correct word order.
Present and Past Tense: Use the present tense more confidently and start using the past tense (perfect tense) for simple narratives.
Question Formation: Form yes/no questions and wh-questions correctly.
Articles and Plurals: Use definite and indefinite articles (de, het, een) and form plurals of nouns.
Adjectives: Use adjectives correctly with nouns, including agreement in gender and number.
Prepositions: Use common prepositions (in, op, bij, naast) to describe location and time.
Modal Verbs: Start using modal verbs (kunnen, moeten, willen) to express ability, necessity, and desire.

Please note that you are expected to speak Spanish in this lesson.
Por favor, ten en cuenta que se espera que hables español en esta lección.

Crosstalk is an amazing way to get exposure to your target language before you're ready to speak. In this lesson, we will have a conversation where I will speak English while you speak Spanish. Please keep in mind that I can only do this with Spanish-speakers, as that is the only language I know other than English.

Crosstalk es una forma increíble de exponerte a tu idioma meta antes de que estés listo para hablarlo. En esta lección, conversamos: yo hablaré en inglés y tú hablarás en español. Por favor, ten en cuenta que solo puedo hacer esto con hispanohablantes, ya que es el único idioma que conozco además del inglés.

course_info.trial_description:
This lesson is all about speaking comfortably and confidently, no pressure, no overthinking grammar. If you understand English/Hindi but feel nervous speaking it out loud, this class is for you.
We’ll focus on real-life conversations and practical speaking tasks like ordering food, making plans, shopping, or handling everyday situations. You’ll get plenty of chances to talk, express your ideas, and build fluency in a relaxed and supportive space.

We can talk about books, shows, travel, culture, daily life, or anything you’re interested in. I may use simple visual prompts or role-play scenarios, but the main focus is always natural conversation.
My goal is to help you stop worrying about mistakes and start speaking with confidence in real life, not just in a classroom.

pro_course_detail.title: English Speaking Plan: Build Confidence & Speak Naturally
pro_course_detail.description:
This 5-lesson plan is designed for learners who already understand English but want to feel confident speaking it out loud. If you often know what you want to say but hesitate, overthink, or stay quiet, this plan is for you.
Across five relaxed, conversation-focused lessons, we’ll practice real-life English through guided speaking tasks, role plays, and open conversations. The focus is on communication, fluency, and comfort, not perfect grammar or memorization.

Each lesson adapts to your pace and interests. We’ll talk about everyday topics like daily life, travel, opinions, culture, books, shows, and real-world situations such as ordering food, making plans, or handling conversations naturally. Visual prompts or short scenarios may be used, but most of the time is spent speaking and interacting.
You’ll receive gentle feedback, natural corrections, and useful phrases you can immediately use outside class. By the end of the 5 lessons, you should feel more relaxed, confident, and willing to speak English without fear of mistakes.

pro_course_detail.title: Speak Like Pakistan Locals
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is perfect for travelers who want to visit Pakistan and communicate confidently in real-life situations. Instead of formal or textbook language, you will learn how people actually speak in everyday conversations across Pakistan.
You’ll practice useful Urdu and simple English phrases for travel situations such as greetings, asking for directions, hotels, transportation, shopping, food, and casual interactions with locals. Along with language, you’ll also gain cultural insights so you can understand how people in Pakistan communicate, behave, and connect in daily life.
This class is focused on practical speaking skills, not memorization—so you can use what you learn immediately during your trip.
By the end of the course, you will be able to:
* Handle common travel conversations in Pakistan with ease
* Understand and respond to local expressions naturally
* Communicate politely and confidently with locals
* Feel comfortable navigating daily life situations in Pakistan
A perfect starting point for travelers who want a real, authentic experience of Pakistan beyond guidebooks.

pro_course_detail.title: From Reader to Speaker: Speak with Confidence!
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to speak English better and feel more confident? This lesson package is a great way to improve your English by focusing on three important skills: reading, speaking, and pronunciation.

----What we will do in each lesson---
1. Read together: 
We will start by reading a short article (5-10 minutes). The topic will be something you are interested in, like technology, travel, or art. This makes learning more fun!
2. Practice pronunciation:
 While we read, we will work on the sounds of new words. You will learn how to say them more clearly and naturally.
3. Have a conversation: 
After we read, we will talk about the article. This is your chance to use the new words you learned and share your ideas. We will have a good conversation, and this will help you speak more easily and with more confidence.

This lesson package helps you with the most important skills for real-life conversations. You will learn new words and feel more confident to speak with others!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
Being able to keep up with conversations is the most important part of learning a language. In these lessons,  I focus on interactive learning, which gives you the opportunity to express yourself on diverse topics ranging from sports, recent news, politics and day-to-day conversations. The conversation may be which can be had in a formal or informal environment.

The lessons are designed to help you learn or improve your verbal communication in everyday English and professional English.

The lessons are focused on:
- Fluency skills
- Accuracy skills
- Confidence boost

pro_course_detail.title: Speak with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to improve your English speaking skills? This lesson is a great way to start! It's a relaxed session where you can practice speaking English.

What you can expect:
      1. A quick chat: 
We'll start with a few simple questions to get to know each other and help me understand your goals.
      2. Casual conversation: 
We'll then talk about topics you find interesting, like hobbies, travel, or movies. This isn't a grammar lesson; it's a chance for you to practice speaking naturally.
       3. Helpful feedback:
 I'll listen carefully and give you gentle corrections and suggestions to help you sound more natural and confident. I'll focus on pronunciation, word choice, and common mistakes.

This lesson is perfect for anyone who wants to:
                1. Build confidence speaking English.
                2. Get comfortable with everyday conversation.
                3. Learn new vocabulary and phrases in a natural way.
                4. Receive personalized feedback.

 I'm excited to meet you!

Welcome to English Basics for Beginners! This lesson package is designed for absolute beginners eager to start their English language journey. We'll cover the foundational elements of English, giving you the confidence to start speaking, understanding, and forming basic sentences.

We will discuss topics like:
                    1. The alphabet & pronunciation
                     2. Numbers (1-100)
                      3. Greetings & introductions
                       4. Basic Vocabulary
                         5. Simple Sentence Structure 
                           6. Asking Simple Questions
                             7. And many more
By the end of this lesson, you'll have a solid foundation in English and be ready to continue building your language skills!

You will learn useful English for everyday work situations. We will have fun, active lessons where you can talk a lot. The goal is to help you feel comfortable speaking with colleagues, clients, and your boss.

Here's what you can expect:
- General business English Vocabulary

- Meetings: Practice expressing opinions, asking questions, and disagreeing respectfully.
- Presentations: Gain confidence in delivering clear and engaging presentations.
- Negotiations: Improve your ability to discuss terms and reach agreements.

exp_info.description: As an English language teacher in an international language community in Hanoi, Vietnam, I teach students of all levels, from beginners to advanced. My students come from various nationalities, and I tailor lessons to meet their needs, helping them improve their language skills and achieve greater fluency in English.

With over four (4) years of experience as a community language tutor, I’ve been recognized as a Top 1% English Teacher by italki in 2022. I’m also the most requested Tagalog and Cebuano-Bisaya teacher, serving students from diverse backgrounds, including those in Hong Kong, China, helping them achieve their language goals.

Teaching English to kids, teens, and adults at various levels—beginner, intermediate, and advanced—involves adapting lessons to suit individual needs. Beginners focus on basic vocabulary and grammar, while intermediate learners work on sentence structure and communication skills. Advanced students refine their fluency and writing, ensuring effective and confident language use.

teacher_info.intro:
About Me
Hi! I’m Teacher Emee, a licensed professional instructor from the Philippines with 9+ years of ESL experience. With a background in Mass Communication and university teaching, I help beginners, business professionals, and IELTS candidates reach their goals. As a mom who raised fluent English speakers, I truly understand the journey of language learning!

Teaching Style
I offer a "mistake-friendly," student-centered classroom where you do most of the talking. Whether you need high-level Business English or fun, reward-based lessons for kids, I ensure every session is warm and productive. Let’s turn your goals into confident English, one chat at a time!

I taught students from beginner to advance level. I know that learning a second language is quite challenging but I always give my students the motivation to keep them going. I am a friendly, patient, and understanding teacher. So, I tell my students that it's okay to make mistakes because from there you will learn to become better if not the best.

When I teach my learners, I make sure their good work will be noticed and give them rewards and praises, especially the young ones. I'm more of a student-centered kind of teacher which means my students will do most of the talking. I believe that this will help them achieve their goals effectively and reach their full potential. My class has a friendly and warm atmosphere and I make sure that my students learn after every lesson.

course_info.trial_description:
Hi. I will be conducting a trial lesson and see if we're a good fit.  We'll start with an introduction to get to know each other first. Our lesson will be about General English and Conversation Practice. But, I want to know more about your needs and goals as to why you want to study English. Because I believe that in this way I can make a lesson plan to help you achieve your desired results. It is very important to know your level if you're an 
 A1, A2, B1, and so on, so the lessons will be according to your English ability. Let me know if you want to use your own materials. But if you have none, I can offer you mine like a pdf file, images, articles, etc. My teaching method is very light and easy to understand. But it is more of a student-centered kind of class.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
The objective for each lesson:
1. To learn about the alphabet plus names
2. To learn about numbers 
3.. To learn the articles a, an, and the.
4. To learn English introductions and farewells
5. To learn about people, places, and nationalities and the questions who, what, and where

Teaching method:
I incorporate different kinds of teaching methods in class depending on the needs of the students. These teaching methods are: 
a. direct method - I use this when a student makes a mistake which I immediately correct and praises him/her when she/he makes a correct answer.
b. communicative language teaching - I use this method to enhance the student's ability to speak English by using real-life contexts like making requests, accepting offers, explaining things, and expressing their feelings and preferences.
c. Total Physical Response - I only use this method when needed especially when a student is struggling in understanding a word or a context.

Materials:
I use a variety of materials related to the lesson but there is also an option for the student to use his or her own materials provided it will be sent to me a day before the class so I can prepare for the lesson plan. My materials are not limited to pdf files, PPT, audio, video, images, articles, and so on.

pro_course_detail.title: Daily English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson focuses on the student's speaking skills. It's more of a free talk type of class. He/She will practice with me without interruption or any correction. However, at the end of the class, I will point out some room for improvement in terms of pronunciation, intonation, and grammar. I will also inject new vocabulary if needed like synonyms,antonyms, etc.

Also, I give feedback to each one of my learners to inform him/her about weaknesses and strengths. I organize challenge activities to create a positive and motivational learning environment. I always put in my mind two facts " Everyone has the right to learn, Everyone is capable to learn."

🔹 Part 1: Warm-up & Introduction (10 minutes)
Simple personal questions (just like IELTS Part 1)
Focus: fluency, comfort, and natural speaking

Sample Questions:

Do you work or study?
What do you usually do in your free time?
Do you prefer mornings or evenings?
🔹 Part 2: Long Turn (Cue Card) (20 minutes)
You will speak for 1–2 minutes
I will teach you how to organize your answer using a clear structure

Sample Topic:
Describe a person who inspires you
You should say:

Who this person is
How you know them
What they do
And explain why they inspire you

👉 Includes:

Idea brainstorming
Vocabulary support
Speaking strategy (no memorization!)
🔹 Part 3: Discussion (Advanced Speaking) (20 minutes)
Deeper questions related to Part 2 topic
Focus: expressing opinions, giving reasons, and critical thinking

Sample Questions:

Why do people need role models?
Do you think success is different for everyone?
How can schools help students become successful?
🔹 Part 4: Feedback & Improvement (10 minutes)
Pronunciation correction
Grammar corrections
Natural expressions & band score tips
Personalized advice to improve your score
🧠 What You Will Learn

Emphasis is placed on communication strategies, problem-solving in workplace situations, and using polite and appropriate business language.

* Handle common business situations with appropriate language
* Improve fluency and accuracy in spoken English

This course is ideal for professionals, students, and job seekers who want to strengthen their English for career growth and global workplace success.

This class is designed for students who are just starting to learn English or who want to build a strong foundation. In this course, we focus on simple vocabulary, basic grammar, and everyday conversations that you can use in real life.

Students will learn how to introduce themselves, ask and answer simple questions, talk about daily activities, and understand common English expressions. We will also practice pronunciation, listening, and speaking to help you communicate more clearly and confidently.

The goal of this class is to help you feel comfortable using basic English in everyday situations. Mistakes are welcome. This is a supportive space to learn and improve step by step.

Students will learn how to express opinions, describe experiences, and talk about past, present, and future events more clearly. We will also practice pronunciation, sentence structure, and listening skills to help you communicate more naturally.

In addition, we will explore how to use punctuation correctly, understand common slang, and learn useful idioms that native speakers use in everyday conversations.

The goal of this class is to help you speak English more smoothly, understand others better, and communicate with greater confidence in real-life situations.

This course is designed to help students build the skills and confidence needed to succeed in major English proficiency exams such as IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, and Cambridge tests. Suitable for learners aged 9 and above, lessons focus on improving reading, writing, listening, and speaking through structured practice and exam-style tasks.

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday English, Travel English, Business English, General English, Exam Preparation Courses (IELTS, TOEFL, KET, etc.)
pro_course_detail.description:
Everyday English
This course focuses on practical English skills for daily life. Topics include common expressions, conversational phrases, and vocabulary for typical interactions such as shopping, dining, and socializing. The course aims to build confidence and fluency in everyday communication situations.

Travel English
Travel English is designed to help learners communicate effectively while traveling. Topics include vocabulary and phrases for booking flights, checking into hotels, asking for directions, dining out, and emergency situations. The goal is to ensure that learners can navigate travel-related scenarios with ease and confidence.

Business English
Business English focuses on language skills needed in a professional environment. Topics include business correspondence, presentations, negotiations, meetings, and networking. The course also covers industry-specific vocabulary and etiquette to help learners effectively communicate in business settings.

General English
General English provides a comprehensive foundation in English language skills, covering reading, writing, listening, and speaking. These courses are structured to suit all proficiency levels, from beginners to advanced learners. They typically include grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and conversational practice to build overall fluency and comprehension.

Exam Preparation Courses (IELTS, TOEFL, KET)
Preparation courses are designed to help learners succeed in specific English proficiency tests.

teacher_info.intro:
Hey, I’m Joao, a certified teacher with 5+ years of experience teaching English and Portuguese, supported by real-world knowledge in finance, history, travel, culture, business, education, technology, and everyday life.

My specialty? Turning conversations into confidence.

Whether you’re learning for work, travel, or daily life, I’ll help you speak naturally and fluently through engaging, real discussions — not textbook drills.

As a language learner myself, I know how frustrating it can feel when words won’t come. But mistakes aren’t setbacks — they’re stepping stones. In my classes, we laugh, we learn, and we practice until speaking feels effortless, not exhausting.

My approach is simple: you start speaking from day one. The fastest way to learn a language is by using it in real, meaningful conversations. You won’t just listen to explanations — you’ll actively take part in guided discussions, role-plays, and practical scenarios that prepare you for authentic communication.

Over the past five years I’ve helped students from varied backgrounds build confidence to express themselves clearly — in everyday conversations, professional settings, or while traveling abroad.

Let’s embark on this language-learning journey together, where mistakes are part of the process and growth is inevitable.

My goal is straightforward: to help you express yourself with clarity and confidence in any situation.

Ready to turn your words into confidence and sound like a pro? Let’s get started.🚀

The part of speech to which a word belongs guides its use in a sentence and defines the correct word and punctuation. Knowing the role that each word has in a sentence structure clearly helps to understand sentences and also  to construct them properly. After learning the Parts of speech, we will practice constructing sentences/questions that you may use in your future travel/references.

pro_course_detail.title: Daily English Free talking
pro_course_detail.description:
To enhance your speaking ability with the help of Daily activity topics.

Here's a more detailed breakdown:
1. Active Listening:
Pay close attention: Focus on what the other person is saying, both verbally and nonverbally. 
Show you're listening: Nod, make eye contact, and use verbal cues like "uh-huh" or "I see". 
Ask clarifying questions: Demonstrate you're engaged by asking questions to understand their perspective. 
Reflect and paraphrase: Summarize what you've heard to ensure understanding and show you're paying attention. 
2. Engaging Questions:
Ask open-ended questions: Encourage detailed responses instead of just "yes" or "no" answers. 
Follow up on answers: Show genuine interest by asking more questions based on their responses. 
Find common ground: Look for shared interests or experiences to build rapport and keep the conversation flowing. 
Avoid leading questions: Don't steer the conversation towards your own opinions or experiences. 
3. Body Language and Tone:
Maintain eye contact: It shows you're engaged and interested in the conversation. 
Use open body language: Avoid crossing your arms or looking down, as these can signal disinterest. 
Speak clearly and at a comfortable pace: Avoid mumbling or speaking too quickly, which can make it difficult to follow. 
Be mindful of your tone: A positive and friendly tone can make conversations more enjoyable.

​What You Will Learn
​This lesson is designed to give you the cultural and linguistic tools to speak like a native within a family setting:
​The Core Family (Koraanai)
Master the essential terms for your immediate circle. We will cover the specific Pashto words for father (Plar), mother (Mor), brother (Ror), and sister (Khor), along with the respectful suffixes used in daily life.

Pashto has unique titles for relatives on different sides of the family. You will learn the difference between your father's brother (Tra) and your mother's brother (Mama), as well as the specific terms for their wives and children (Azeezan).
​The Concept of "Ghairat" and "Izzat"
Understand the cultural values of honor and respect. I will teach you the polite forms of address (Mashar vs. Kashar) and how to properly greet elders and guests in a traditional Pashto environment.
​Conversational Scenarios
Practice real-life conversations: how to introduce your family, how to ask about someone’s well-being (Khaireyat), and the specific idioms used during family gatherings and weddings.

pro_course_detail.title: A1 to A2 speaking practice and grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
Speaking Practice
Basic Conversations: Engage in simple dialogues about familiar topics such as daily activities, personal information, and hobbies.
Asking and Answering Questions: Practice asking for and giving directions, making purchases, and ordering food in a restaurant.
Describing: Learn to describe your surroundings, family, and friends with more detail.
Expressing Preferences: Talk about your likes, dislikes, and preferences.
Role-Playing: Simulate real-life situations such as visiting the doctor, making travel arrangements, or shopping.
Improving Pronunciation: Focus on clear pronunciation and intonation to be better understood.
Using Common Expressions: Use everyday expressions and phrases to sound more natural.
Grammar
Sentence Structure: Understand and use basic sentence structures with correct word order.
Present and Past Tense: Use the present tense more confidently and start using the past tense (perfect tense) for simple narratives.
Question Formation: Form yes/no questions and wh-questions correctly.
Articles and Plurals: Use definite and indefinite articles (de, het, een) and form plurals of nouns.
Adjectives: Use adjectives correctly with nouns, including agreement in gender and number.
Prepositions: Use common prepositions (in, op, bij, naast) to describe location and time.
Modal Verbs: Start using modal verbs (kunnen, moeten, willen) to express ability, necessity, and desire.

We focus on real-life administrative tasks such as managing emails, scheduling meetings, following up with clients, responding to requests, and providing clear updates to managers and team members. You will learn how to communicate in a way that is professional, polite, and efficient.

During the lesson, you will practice through realistic scenarios based on your daily responsibilities. I will guide you step by step, correct your mistakes, and upgrade your sentences so you can immediately apply what you learn in your workplace.

As aulas são personalizadas e adaptadas às necessidades reais de cada pessoa, criando um ambiente seguro para aprender, errar e evoluir.

Todo o material é desenvolvido por mim, a partir da minha experiência prática em sala de aula e da minha vivência internacional com a língua inglesa. Os exercícios e atividades são planejados para facilitar a compreensão e fortalecer a confiança do aluno ao longo do processo.

pro_course_detail.description:
A melhor forma de aprender uma língua é fazendo uso dela constantemente! 

Por isso, esta aula de conversação em inglês -  do nível básico (A1) ao intermediário (B1) -  é dedicada exclusivamente à prática da fala. Durante uma hora, o foco é conversar, se expressar e usar o inglês de forma espontânea, sem apoio de materiais, apostilas ou exercícios formais.

As conversas são conduzidas de forma personalizada, respeitando o nível, os interesses e os objetivos de cada aluno. A partir da interação real, o aluno é encorajado a organizar ideias, ampliar vocabulário naturalmente e ganhar fluidez, sempre em um ambiente seguro e acolhedor.

Com base na minha experiência em sala de aula, vivência internacional com o idioma e conhecimentos de psicologia e pedagogia, a aula é guiada para reduzir bloqueios, ansiedade e medo de errar. O objetivo é fortalecer a confiança e tornar o inglês uma ferramenta viva de comunicação.

pro_course_detail.description:
IELTS for Kids and Teens program is designed to introduce young learners to the skills needed for the IELTS exam in a fun, interactive, and age-appropriate way. The lessons focus on building strong foundations in English while helping students become confident with the test format and question types.

Students learn and practice all four key skills:

Speaking – improving fluency, pronunciation, and confidence through games, role-plays, and guided conversations.

Listening – developing careful listening through short audio activities, real-life situations, and practice questions.

Reading – building comprehension skills with engaging texts that match their age and English level.

Writing – learning how to organize ideas, write simple paragraphs, and gradually build up to IELTS-style tasks.

Each lesson includes:

Vocabulary building using themed word lists for common IELTS topics

Interactive activities such as pair work, quizzes, storytelling, and problem-solving

Practice exercises that slowly introduce IELTS-type questions

Teacher feedback to help students improve step by step

This course helps young learners:

Gain early familiarity with the IELTS exam

Improve overall English communication skills

Build confidence and reduce test anxiety

Develop good study habits for future academic success

🇰🇪 About 60-70% of Kenyans use Swahili in daily life

🌍 Over 150 million speakers across East and Central Africa

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Angel from South Africa — a friendly, patient, and encouraging English teacher who helps students speak English more confidently and naturally.

Do you feel nervous when speaking English? Do you understand English but struggle to reply quickly or sound natural? You’re not alone — and that’s exactly what we’ll work on together 😊

My lessons are relaxed, interactive, and focused on real communication. I help students improve:
✨ Conversational Fluency
✨ Pronunciation & Vocabulary
✨ Speaking Confidence
✨ IELTS Speaking
✨ Business & Travel English

In my classroom, mistakes are welcome because that’s how learning happens! I create a comfortable space where you can practice speaking freely without pressure.

I use real-life conversations, interesting topics, reading activities, pronunciation practice, and personalized materials based on your goals and interests. Whether you want to improve your English for work, travel, studies, interviews, or everyday conversations, I will guide you step by step.

Students describe me as supportive, easy to talk to, and motivating. I truly enjoy helping people from different cultures grow in confidence while making learning enjoyable.

Outside teaching, I enjoy reading, hiking, personal growth, and meaningful conversations.

Let’s make your English journey fun, practical, and confidence-building. See you in class! 😊

course_info.trial_description:
In our trial lesson, we will get to know each other and discuss your goals for learning English. I’ll assess your current level through a short conversation and some simple activities. Together, we’ll create a learning plan that fits your needs, whether it’s speaking, grammar, business English, or exam preparation.

This is a relaxed session — no pressure! It’s your chance to see my teaching style and ask any questions before starting regular lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Confident Conversational English (General Fluency)
pro_course_detail.description: Do you want to speak English more naturally and confidently in everyday situations? In this lesson, we will focus on conversation practice around interesting topics that matter to you. I’ll help you correct mistakes, improve your vocabulary, and speak with confidence. These lessons are relaxed, fun, and designed to build your fluency step by step.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation & Vocabulary Builder
pro_course_detail.description: Do you want to improve your pronunciation and sound more natural? In these lessons, we will work on word stress, sentence rhythm, and clear pronunciation through reading stories, dialogues, and fun speaking exercises. At the same time, you’ll learn new vocabulary that you can use right away in conversation.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Preparation
pro_course_detail.description: If you’re preparing for IELTS, this lesson will help you with the speaking test. We will practice answering Part 1, 2, and 3 questions with confidence, learn how to extend your answers, and work on fluency, pronunciation, and vocabulary. I’ll also give you feedback and tips to improve your score.

pro_course_detail.title: Travel English: English for Everyday Adventures

pro_course_detail.title: Portuguese From The Start – For Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
This Portuguese class for beginners is designed to teach the basics of the language in a practical and applied way. Instead of focusing only on grammar rules, our main goal is to help students improve their real-life communication skills and feel confident using Portuguese in everyday situations.
The class is structured step by step, combining essential vocabulary, useful phrases, everyday expressions, simple grammar explanation, always reinforced with practical examples and speaking exercises. We will simulate real-life conversations such as introducing yourself, asking for information, shopping, or having a casual chat.

 What you can expect from this class:

✔️ Basic and functional vocabulary (greetings, introductions, everyday objects)

✔️ Simple sentence structures (affirmative, negative, and interrogative)

✔️ Practical communication scenarios (e.g., making requests, talking about yourself, expressing needs)

✔️ Natural pronunciation and intonation

✔️ Tips to start thinking in Portuguese and build confidence

Nesta aula de português para iniciantes, vamos aprender o básico da língua de forma prática, simples e aplicada ao dia a dia. Em vez de focar apenas em regras gramaticais, nosso objetivo será desenvolver a comunicação real do aluno, ajudando-o a se expressar melhor em situações comuns da vida cotidiana.

With over 3 years of experience, I help learners speak confidently in everyday and professional settings. Whether you’re a complete beginner or looking to polish your conversation skills, you’ve come to the right place!

Originally from Zimbabwe, I’ve lived in the UK, Zambia , and recently Türkiye. My multilingual journey (Shona native, French basics) fuels my love for connecting across cultures. 

When not teaching, I co-run a family business, bake🎂, travel🌍, and make music🎶. 
Let’s turn your English goals into fluent conversations!
teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a teacher, I’m known to be patient and understanding. I create a relaxed space where you’re encouraged to express yourself freely—without fear of making mistakes. In fact, mistakes are part of the learning process, and I’m here to guide you through them with support and encouragement.

My specialty is conversation practice, perfect for adults and teens who want to improve their speaking and listening skills for everyday life. We’ll focus on real English you can use in daily conversations—helping you sound more natural, fluent, and confident.

Let’s work together to make English feel comfortable and natural!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I believe every student is unique, so my teaching methods differ per student's needs. 
I offer 2 different types of lessons:

👉English conversation practice
Here we work on developing your conversational skills and we can speak about any topic of your choice.
However, in our conversations I will be focusing on your grammar, pronunciation and articulation so you can get the best out of our lesson times.🤝

👉General English 
In this lesson we work on improving your reading, pronunciation and writing skills. 📚 We do this by reading through a variety of articles and then discussing about them . You are free to choose which articles we cover. Homework is usually given for writing practice.

teacher_info.intro:
I’m a medical doctor and health specialist at the World Health Organization with over 15 years of experience working in international environments, including in Switzerland and Germany. English has been my main working language throughout my career, and I achieved an overall IELTS Academic score of 8.5 with minimal preparation.

Alongside my work, I’ve taught English through Berlitz, GCSE-level instruction, and volunteer work with children and migrants. I enjoy helping people express themselves clearly and confidently, and I bring a structured yet relaxed approach to every session.

As a teacher, I combine experience from both ends of the spectrum: developing and delivering trainings for WHO staff and healthcare professionals, and teaching English in informal settings with underprivileged children and migrant communities. This has made my approach both adaptable and supportive: creating a comfortable environment for speaking practice while providing practical guidance to improve fluency and confidence.

My lessons are practical and conversation-focused. Depending on your goals, we can focus on:
• Everyday conversation and fluency
• Job applications and interview preparation
• IELTS/TOEFL speaking practice
• Professional communication

I tailor each session to your level and goals to ensure lessons are engaging, useful, and relevant to your needs.

pro_course_detail.title: From Pre-Speech to Basic Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed to guide students from pre-speech stages to basic conversational skills in Portuguese. The core of this lesson is based on providing comprehensible input—language that is understandable and meaningful, even if it contains some unfamiliar words. For students at A1 to A2 levels, this comprehensible input comes from both the teacher’s speech and the materials used. The goal is to introduce students to real-life language in a way that feels natural and intuitive, drawing on Stephen Krashen’s Natural Approach to language acquisition.

The lesson starts with pre-speech activities. During this stage, students engage with simple, everyday vocabulary through context, images, and gestures. For example, they might learn common greetings like “Olá!” (Hello) or “Como vai?” (How are you?), with the teacher providing visual cues to reinforce meaning.

Following this, the class moves into a more structured yet still interactive phase, where students start practicing short sentences. During this stage, the students focus on words and phrases that are useful in daily conversations. For example, they might listen to a simple conversation, like "Qual é o seu nome?" (What’s your name?) and respond by choosing the correct answer.

Finally, we move to basic conversation practice, where students actively use the language to respond to simple questions, like "Onde você mora?" (Where do you live?). This part, lasting around 15 minutes, emphasizes speaking in short, meaningful exchanges. The focus remains on keeping input at a level that is understandable for the students, ensuring they can participate in the conversation even if it’s their first attempt.

Throughout the class, all material and teacher input are carefully chosen to align with A1 to A2 proficiency levels, promoting both understanding and practical language use. This approach ensures that students feel comfortable and supported as they develop their skills.

pro_course_detail.title: The Power of Reading: Unlocking Language Acquisition Through Texts
pro_course_detail.description:
Reading is one of the most powerful tools for language acquisition, and in this class, we’ll explore how it can transform your ability to learn Portuguese naturally and effectively. According to Stephen Krashen’s theories, reading allows you to see vocabulary and grammar in meaningful contexts, making it easier to absorb the language subconsciously. When you read, you encounter the same words and structures repeatedly, but in different situations, which helps your brain internalize them without the need for memorization or drills. Common words and phrases appear naturally through the texts, reinforcing their meaning and usage in a way that feels effortless and enjoyable.

In this class, I’ll guide you through methods to develop your reading skills in Portuguese, tailored to your level and goals. We’ll use tools like graded readers, which are books specifically designed for language learners. These texts are adapted to different proficiency levels, starting with simple vocabulary and short sentences for beginners and gradually increasing in complexity as you progress. Graded readers allow you to read for pleasure while staying within your comfort zone, ensuring comprehension and building confidence.

I’ll also help you find other written materials suited to your level, such as short stories, news articles, or even children’s books. The key is to choose texts that are interesting and comprehensible, so you stay motivated and engaged. Through guided reading activities, we’ll work on strategies like predicting content, identifying key words, and inferring meaning from context. Over time, you’ll notice your vocabulary expanding, your understanding of grammar improving, and your ability to read more complex texts growing—all while enjoying the process.

By immersing yourself in reading, you’ll not only acquire the language naturally but also develop a deeper connection with Portuguese culture and its rich literary traditions.

pro_course_detail.title: "Batendo um Papo" – Relaxed Conversations for Real Communication
pro_course_detail.description:
“Bater um papo” is a Brazilian Portuguese expression that means having a casual, friendly conversation—just like chatting with a friend over coffee. And that’s exactly what this class is about: natural, stress-free communication to help you develop your speaking skills with confidence.

According to linguist Stephen Krashen, communication is the key to language acquisition. The goal is to be understood, not to be perfect. Native speakers want to understand you, and small mistakes don’t matter as long as the message gets across. In fact, obsessing over errors can create anxiety and slow down your progress. That’s why my approach focuses on creating a low-stress, comfortable environment where you can express yourself freely.

Conversation is one of the most powerful tools for language learning because it helps your brain form strong connections between words, meanings, and real-life situations. The more you engage in meaningful discussions, the more naturally the language will come to you.

We can talk about a wide range of topics, depending on your interests. I love arts, music, literature, and cinema from all countries and periods—including silent films. I also enjoy trekking, exploring nature, and traveling to learn about different cultures. As a teacher of History, Politics, and Philosophy, I’m always up for deep and thought-provoking discussions. And if you’re into video games, board games, RPGs, or language learning (I’m currently studying French!), we can chat about those as well.

In our conversations, I’ll provide guidance when needed, introduce new vocabulary naturally, and gently correct mistakes that might affect comprehension. But above all, my goal is to make you feel comfortable and motivated to express yourself in Portuguese. Let’s have a chat and enjoy the journey of language learning together!

Our lessons will start with your own writing—whether it's an email, an essay, or a short text. I will carefully review it, providing detailed feedback on clarity, coherence, vocabulary, grammar, and style. But this is not just about correcting mistakes. I will help you understand alternative ways to express your ideas, making your writing more fluid and natural.

To make the learning process dynamic and engaging, we will use various techniques:

What we will cover in this class:
• The IPA Advantage: Learn the 44 distinct sounds of English using the phonetic alphabet so you can confidently pronounce any word in the dictionary.
• Pronunciation & Accent Training: Fix persistent mistakes, master mouth/tongue positioning, and practice natural word connections.
• Listening & Reading Alignment: Read texts phonetically and train your ear to recognize subtle differences in spoken English sounds.

Whether you want to reduce your accent, sound more natural, or easily understand fast native speech, this structured, feedback-heavy lesson will transform your English!

course_info.trial_description:
You may have asked yourself whether there is some effective method that can make you speak English fluently, efficiently, and with confidence.
Well, there is such a method!
With my English Conversation Dialogues, you can immerse yourself in real English conversations that tell an authentic story through a variety of dialogues. Each lesson builds upon the narrative by featuring short, genuine exchanges between native English speakers in both formal and informal settings. You will find conversations between close friends, coworkers, family members, classmates, and strangers that will help prepare you to speak English in the real world.
Along the way, you'll also find several situational scenarios from daily life to improve your English language ability. These include picking up prescriptions at the pharmacy, checking out books from the library, and ordering food at a restaurant.
Each dialogue has been written and edited by native English speakers, so you can be sure that you are getting the most natural English grammar, vocabulary, and phrases.
Each lesson also comes with comprehension questions to test your understanding of the story and the English used. No drills or grammatical exercises are necessary to learn English!
my language learning method focuses on the power of extensive reading and listening to achieve fluency.

teacher_info.teaching_style: I aim to teach and share three languages: English, Tagalog, and Cebuano. I provide intensive training for the specific tasks required by each exam:

TCF Preparation (Tasks 1, 2, & 3):

Task 1: Master the spontaneous exchange.

Task 2: Learn how to ask the right questions to gather information effectively.

Task 3: Structure your arguments clearly to express opinions on complex topics.

TEF Preparation (Tasks 1 & 2):

Section A: Perfect your information-gathering through formal and informal roleplay.

Section B: Master the art of persuasion and argumentation to convince your interlocutor.

### A Comprehensive Approach to Success
While we focus on the speaking component, I provide a holistic approach to ensure you are ready for every part of the exam:

Full Exam Support: Beyond Oral Expression, I can assist you with Oral Comprehension, Written Expression, and Reading Comprehension. I will guide you through the logic of the entire exam so there are no surprises on test day.

Exclusive Resource Library: My students gain access to a vast collection of preparation materials, including past exam topics, specialized vocabulary lists, audio samples, and structural templates that you can use to "plug and play" your answers.

Official Criteria: We practice based on the specific grading rubrics used by examiners: fluency, vocabulary range, and grammatical precision.

Mock Exams: Experience a simulated exam environment with a timer and professional feedback to eliminate "stage fright."

"Don't just practice until you get it right. Practice until you can't get it wrong." Book your session today, and let’s start working with the best materials and strategies.

I have helped quite a few students reach their required band score! One student increased his speaking band score by 2 levels! They are now able to study and work abroad. Another teenage student went from A1 - C1 in about 3 years!

I will identify the areas where you are struggling and create an effective plan to correct those mistakes. I will be offering you some tips and strategies to make sure that you are ready to ace your exam! You will feel empowered to face the exam head-on. The student will also be able to pay more attention to their areas of weakness while improving their areas of strength. 

Your progress will be measurable. As part of your continual learning, I also send short videos or audio on request, that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

Business English
Business English focuses on language skills needed in a professional environment. Topics include business correspondence, presentations, negotiations, meetings, and networking. General English
General English provides a comprehensive foundation in English language skills, covering reading, writing, listening, and speaking. These courses are structured to suit all proficiency levels, from beginners to advanced learners. teacher_info.about_teacher: The way I see language learning is a bit philosophical but it also came from my personal experience after being both a student and a teacher for a while. I envision the process of language learning to be similar to the process of growing a tree; you need patience and take care of the plant on a regular basis to get a result that normally can not be pushed ahead of time...But you can always add-in some fertilizers (which are in my case a certain set of technics) to get improved results in terms of time and quality.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Lessons: I prefer that you book packages to show commitment and also to get along with the nature of the process ( as I explained earlier: expect to practice on a regular basis ! ), I am very flexible and I don't have a problem canceling or reporting lessons... I can also use instant messaging apps like Whatsapp if you feel like learning and practicing on the go. 
Let's talk technics: I am not a big fan of the Pimsleur method unless it's used with some other tools to remember the vocabulary you learned. For example, Anki flashcards. I prefer to rely on the spaced repetition system proposed by apps like Duolingo and Memrise.

pro_course_detail.title: Legal English
pro_course_detail.description:
This Legal English Course provides targeted training to enhance your understanding and use of the "lingua legalis" (legal language).
Here’s a breakdown of key topics and skills that can be taught:

1. Legal Vocabulary
Terminology: Learn essential legal terms and phrases used in various areas of law (e.g., contract law, criminal law, corporate law).
Idiomatic Expressions: Understand common idioms and phrases that are frequently used in legal contexts.

2. Legal Writing Skills
Drafting Documents: Techniques for writing contracts, briefs, memos, and letters.
Legal Analysis: Learn how to analyze and summarize legal texts clearly and concisely.
Citation Formats: Familiarization with proper citation styles.

3. Oral Communication
Presentations: Skills for presenting legal arguments effectively.
Negotiation Techniques: Strategies for negotiating contracts and settlements.
Courtroom Skills: Practice for speaking in court, including direct examination and cross-examination.

4. Reading Comprehension
Case Law Analysis: Techniques for reading and interpreting case law and legal opinions.
Statutory Interpretation: Understanding how to read and analyze statutes and regulations.

5. Practical Applications
Mock Trials: Participate in simulated trials to apply your skills in a real-world context.
Role-Playing Exercises: Engage in role-playing scenarios to practice negotiation and client interaction.

6. Cultural Aspects of Law
Legal Systems: Overview of different legal systems (common law vs. civil law) and their terminology.

My teaching style is informal, relaxed, and tailored to your goals. Whether you’re learning for travel, work, or personal growth, I’ll help you speak naturally like the current generation.
