pro_course_detail.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations
pro_course_detail.description:
"Academic Support for Researchers." Stuck with your simulation scripts? I offer technical guidance for students and researchers. Tools: GROMACS, LAMMPS, VMD.
Focus: Debugging, setting up systems, and analyzing trajectories.

Depending on your interest and level, we can explore practical topics such as:
	•	Setting up simple molecular systems
	•	Running basic MD simulations using popular software like LAMMPS, GROMACS, or Materials Studio
	•	Understanding simulation outputs (trajectories, energies, thermodynamic properties)
	•	Analyzing data using tools like Ovito, VMD, or Python libraries (MDAnalysis, MDTraj)

Whether you are a beginner or someone looking to polish your simulation and analysis skills, the lesson will be tailored to your needs. I will ensure our sessions are interactive and oriented towards practical application. No prior coding or MD experience is strictly necessary - just curiosity and willingness to learn!

Checkout NanoScaleModelling YouTube channel where I post some of my MD related work.
Note: Please message me your problem statement before booking.

pro_course_detail.title: Hindi Speaking Lab

Topics: Daily Life, Travel, Society, Tech, or Open Talk.

Note
● This lesson does not include archaic Hindi vocab (Hindi not used in daily life like bathroom=गुसलखाना).
●This lesson does not include grammatical portions.
◉ If your availability does not match with the tutor's, try sending a message.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate Tagalog Language
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson helps you to understand the Filipino (Tagalog) language more. We will learn the Parts of speech such as Adjective (pang-uri), verb (pandiwa), and noun (pangalan) in Tagalog. The part of speech indicates how the word functions in meaning as well as grammatically within the sentence. The part of speech to which a word belongs guides its use in a sentence and defines the correct word and punctuation. Knowing the role that each word has in a sentence structure clearly helps to understand sentences and also  to construct them properly. After learning the Parts of speech, we will practice constructing sentences/questions that you may use in your future travel/references.

Hi! I’m Teacher Anne, a licensed teacher with 14 years of experience helping kids and adults speak confidently. 🎓✨
For kids, I turn lessons into playful adventures with songs and visuals—because laughter makes learning stick! For adults, I focus on practical English for work, travel, or daily chats, tailored to your goals.
What makes my classes special? I weave *your* culture and interests into our lessons, making English feel natural and fun. Whether you’re shy or stuck at a language plateau, I’ll guide you patiently—step by step. Let’s grow your skills together! 🌍🗣️

I love teaching English to people from various nationalities because to gain a deeper understanding of their culture through our conversations.

My lessons primarily focus on free conversation for adults, allowing us to discuss a wide range of topics such as travel, food, current events, and many others. Likewise, I also offer motivating lessons for kids of all ages.

course_info.trial_description:
The trial lesson is a relaxed 30-minute session designed for us to get to know each other and make sure we’re a good fit.

During the trial lesson, we will:
- Talk about your goals, needs, and learning style
- Do a short level check through conversation or simple activities (student specific)
- Identify your strengths and areas to improve
- Discuss a clear learning plan moving forward

This lesson is pressure-free and supportive ,there are no expectations to be perfect. It’s simply a chance to feel comfortable, ask questions, and see how lessons will work.
By the end of the trial, you’ll have a clear idea of what to expect and how we can work together to reach your goals

pro_course_detail.title: CHILDREN & TEENAGERS: FUN,CONFIDENT ENGLISH LEARNING (AGES 8-18)
pro_course_detail.description:
I offer engaging, supportive English lessons where children and teens build confidence while learning naturally.

Lessons focus on:
- Vocabulary, pronunciation, and speaking confidence.
- Learning colours, numbers, shapes, and age-appropriate topics.

Activities are adapted to each learner’s age, personality, and learning style. Nothing is forced, methods are introduced gradually in a calm, encouraging environment.

pro_course_detail.title: English teacher for all types of students, Fun, interactive lessons await! Dive into engaging English learning today.
pro_course_detail.description: Unlock your potential and broaden your horizons by mastering English as a second language with me! With my personalized and engaging teaching approach, you'll gain the confidence to communicate effectively in diverse settings. I understand the ups and downs, the struggles with learning a new language, the frustration when trying to express oneself, and all the challenges. I know that certain grammar topics can be difficult and require practice, but also that pronunciation can be a real challenge, which is why conversation, speaking, and listening are important! I want to help you reach your goal of being a fluent English speaker! You can do it, and I will help you get there! The most important thing is to use the language, and I want to help you do that! I am friendly, approachable, curious, knowledgeable, and love to help others learn. No question is a stupid question, and I am always open to helping you understand everything that may be unclear to you! Together, we'll explore the nuances of the language, enhance your pronunciation, and expand your vocabulary, making you fluent and ready for global opportunities. Using the direct method of language instruction, I help students learn and begin to think in English. Using the communicative language teaching method, I help students discuss real-life situations to build their language skills to use in their daily lives. Don't miss the chance to improve your skills in a supportive and inspiring environment where your progress is my priority. You've taken the first step toward your language goals, and now is the best time to keep your commitment to yourself and take your skills to the next level. See you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Daily English Free talking
pro_course_detail.description:
To enhance your speaking ability with the help of Daily activity topics.

Here's a more detailed breakdown:
1. Active Listening:
Pay close attention: Focus on what the other person is saying, both verbally and nonverbally. 
Show you're listening: Nod, make eye contact, and use verbal cues like "uh-huh" or "I see". 
Ask clarifying questions: Demonstrate you're engaged by asking questions to understand their perspective. 
Reflect and paraphrase: Summarize what you've heard to ensure understanding and show you're paying attention. 
2. Engaging Questions:
Ask open-ended questions: Encourage detailed responses instead of just "yes" or "no" answers. 
Follow up on answers: Show genuine interest by asking more questions based on their responses. 
Find common ground: Look for shared interests or experiences to build rapport and keep the conversation flowing. 
Avoid leading questions: Don't steer the conversation towards your own opinions or experiences. 
3. Body Language and Tone:
Maintain eye contact: It shows you're engaged and interested in the conversation. 
Use open body language: Avoid crossing your arms or looking down, as these can signal disinterest. 
Speak clearly and at a comfortable pace: Avoid mumbling or speaking too quickly, which can make it difficult to follow. 
Be mindful of your tone: A positive and friendly tone can make conversations more enjoyable.

​What You Will Learn
​This lesson is designed to give you the cultural and linguistic tools to speak like a native within a family setting:
​The Core Family (Koraanai)
Master the essential terms for your immediate circle. We will cover the specific Pashto words for father (Plar), mother (Mor), brother (Ror), and sister (Khor), along with the respectful suffixes used in daily life.
​Paternal & Maternal Lineage
Pashto has unique titles for relatives on different sides of the family. You will learn the difference between your father's brother (Tra) and your mother's brother (Mama), as well as the specific terms for their wives and children (Azeezan).
​The Concept of "Ghairat" and "Izzat"
Understand the cultural values of honor and respect. I will teach you the polite forms of address (Mashar vs. Kashar) and how to properly greet elders and guests in a traditional Pashto environment.
​Conversational Scenarios
Practice real-life conversations: how to introduce your family, how to ask about someone’s well-being (Khaireyat), and the specific idioms used during family gatherings and weddings.

pro_course_detail.description:

Whether for vacation, family visits, volunteering, or cultural immersion, learners will build essential speaking and listening skills through simple, structured, and interactive lessons.

The course focuses on everyday conversational Tagalog, helping students confidently handle common travel situations such as greetings, asking for directions, ordering food, shopping, transportation, hotel stays, and basic social interactions. Each day includes:

Practical vocabulary for real travel situations
Simple grammar explanations (no heavy theory)
Dialogue practice and role-playing activities
Listening exercises using native-style conversations
Pronunciation guidance for clear communication
Cultural tips to help learners interact respectfully and naturally

pro_course_detail.title: English Expressways Reading and Language for Beginner Elementary
pro_course_detail.description:
English Expressways: Reading and Language (Grade 1) is a learning material or approach designed to help young learners develop basic English communication and literacy skills in a fun, interactive way. It combines reading, speaking, and language activities suitable for early elementary pupils.

📘 Description

The English Expressways (Grade 1)program focuses on guiding learners through a “journey” of learning English, where they practice different skills step by step. It uses stories, pictures, and activities to make learning meaningful and enjoyable.

 🧩 Key Features

*1. Reading Skills Development

* Pupils read short and simple texts with pictures.
* They learn to understand stories by identifying:

  * Characters, setting, and events
  * Main idea and details
* They practice retelling stories and answering questions. 

*2. Phonics and Word Recognition

* Focus on letter sounds and how letters form words.
* Includes rhyming words, blending sounds, and recognizing common sight words. ([K5 Learning][2])

*3. Vocabulary Building

* Introduces simple words related to:

  * Family, school, and everyday life
* Helps learners understand meanings using pictures and context. 

*4. Grammar and Language Use

* Teaches basic sentence structure (simple sentences).
* Introduces:

  * Nouns (names of people, places, things)
  * Action words and describing words
* Uses correct capitalization and punctuation. ([K5 Learning]

*5. Speaking and Listening

* Encourages students to:

  * Talk about themselves and their experiences
  * Use polite expressions (e.g., greetings, thank you, sorry)
* Develops confidence in communicating in English. 

*6. Interactive Learning Approach

* Uses:
  * Role-playing
  * Group activities
  * Songs, rhymes, and discussions
* Promotes active participation and critical thinking.

pro_course_detail.title: A1 to A2 speaking practice and grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
Speaking Practice
Basic Conversations: Engage in simple dialogues about familiar topics such as daily activities, personal information, and hobbies.
Asking and Answering Questions: Practice asking for and giving directions, making purchases, and ordering food in a restaurant.
Describing: Learn to describe your surroundings, family, and friends with more detail.
Expressing Preferences: Talk about your likes, dislikes, and preferences.
Role-Playing: Simulate real-life situations such as visiting the doctor, making travel arrangements, or shopping.
Improving Pronunciation: Focus on clear pronunciation and intonation to be better understood.
Using Common Expressions: Use everyday expressions and phrases to sound more natural.
Grammar
Sentence Structure: Understand and use basic sentence structures with correct word order.
Present and Past Tense: Use the present tense more confidently and start using the past tense (perfect tense) for simple narratives.
Question Formation: Form yes/no questions and wh-questions correctly.
Articles and Plurals: Use definite and indefinite articles (de, het, een) and form plurals of nouns.
Adjectives: Use adjectives correctly with nouns, including agreement in gender and number.
Prepositions: Use common prepositions (in, op, bij, naast) to describe location and time.
Modal Verbs: Start using modal verbs (kunnen, moeten, willen) to express ability, necessity, and desire.

My lessons are student-centered and adapted to your personal goals, whether you want to speak more naturally, prepare for interviews, improve academic English, or feel more confident using English in daily situations. I create a relaxed and supportive learning environment where mistakes are welcome and learning feels comfortable. I enjoy meeting people from different cultures and helping them express themselves clearly in English.
teacher_info.about_teacher: As a teacher, I focus on creating a calm, friendly, and supportive learning environment where students feel comfortable speaking English without fear of making mistakes. I am patient, attentive, and adaptable, and I always try to understand each student’s goals, level, and interests. I believe learning works best when lessons are practical and enjoyable, so I encourage natural conversation, active participation, and real-life examples. I guide students gently, give clear feedback, and help them build confidence step by step. My goal is to help learners feel more comfortable expressing themselves clearly and naturally in English.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are relaxed, interactive, and focused on helping students feel comfortable using English. I adapt each lesson to the student’s level, goals, and interests, with a strong focus on speaking practice and real-life communication. Lessons may include guided conversations, vocabulary building, pronunciation practice, and simple exercises to support understanding. I encourage students to speak as much as possible and see mistakes as part of the learning process. My teaching style is patient and supportive, and I aim to create a positive environment where students can practice English with confidence and enjoy the learning experience.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Everyday Life
pro_course_detail.description: Do you want to speak English more easily in your daily life? In this lesson, we'll focus on everyday conversations like, chatting with friends, shopping, ordering food, and talking about your hobbies. You will practice natural phrases, improve your fluency, and gain the confidence to use English in real life situations. Whether you're just starting your English journey or already fluent, this lesson is for you. Beginners get patient guidance and clear support, while advanced learners enjoy engaging conversations to keep their English sharp and natural.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar secrets: Learn the Rules of English in a Simple way
pro_course_detail.description: Grammar doesn't have to be boring or complicated! In my lessons, I turn grammar into something practical and easy to use. You'll learn the rules step-by-step, discover how they actually work in everyday English, and get plenty of speaking practice to make them stick. Whether you're building a strong foundation as a beginner or fine-tuning your accuracy as an advanced learner, I'll help you use grammar confidently, correctly, and naturally.

pro_course_detail.title: Master English Pronunciation: Speak Fluently in no Time
pro_course_detail.description: Do you want to sound clearer and more natural when you speak English? In this lesson, we'll focus on pronunciation, stress, and intonation so that people understand you easily and you feel more confident. You'll practice tricky sounds, learn how native speakers connect words, and train your ear to hear the difference. Whether you're a beginner who needs a step-by-step guidance or an advanced learner polishing your accent, I'll help you speak English with clarity, confidence, and style.

pro_course_detail.title: High-Stakes Business Communication (Meetings, Conflict & Influence)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, I help professionals communicate effectively in high-pressure workplace situations. You will learn how to express ideas clearly, handle disagreements diplomatically, and speak with confidence in meetings and discussions.

This lesson focuses on real-life business scenarios such as managing conflict, presenting ideas, and responding professionally under pressure. I provide detailed feedback and help you upgrade your language so you sound more natural, confident, and impactful at work.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Administrative Professionals: Office Communication Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, I help administrative professionals develop the communication skills they need to perform confidently and effectively in a modern office environment. Whether you are an administrative assistant, virtual assistant, office coordinator, or support staff, this lesson is designed to improve the way you communicate in English at work.

We focus on real-life administrative tasks such as managing emails, scheduling meetings, following up with clients, responding to requests, and providing clear updates to managers and team members. You will learn how to communicate in a way that is professional, polite, and efficient.

A key part of this lesson is improving your tone and clarity. Many professionals struggle with sounding too direct, too informal, or unclear in English. I will help you adjust your language so you sound more natural, confident, and organized in every situation.

During the lesson, you will practice through realistic scenarios based on your daily responsibilities. I will guide you step by step, correct your mistakes, and upgrade your sentences so you can immediately apply what you learn in your workplace.

This lesson is highly interactive and personalized to your role, ensuring that you gain practical skills that make a real difference in your day-to-day communication.

pro_course_detail.description:
* Valores válidos para alunos que fizeram aula comigo até 25/04. A partir de 25/05, os valores serão atualizados.

As aulas são personalizadas e adaptadas às necessidades reais de cada pessoa, criando um ambiente seguro para aprender, errar e evoluir.

Todo o material é desenvolvido por mim, a partir da minha experiência prática em sala de aula e da minha vivência internacional com a língua inglesa. Os exercícios e atividades são planejados para facilitar a compreensão e fortalecer a confiança do aluno ao longo do processo.

O método une minha trajetória como professora de inglês aos conhecimentos de psicologia e pedagogia, valorizando não apenas o conteúdo, mas também os aspectos emocionais e cognitivos envolvidos no aprendizado de uma nova língua. O objetivo é construir uma base sólida, para que o inglês seja apenas a porta de entrada para desenvolvimento pessoal, conhecimento e acesso a novas culturas.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's chat! Aula de conversação em inglês: básico (A1) ao intermediário (B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
A melhor forma de aprender uma língua é fazendo uso dela constantemente! 

Por isso, esta aula de conversação em inglês -  do nível básico (A1) ao intermediário (B1) -  é dedicada exclusivamente à prática da fala. Durante uma hora, o foco é conversar, se expressar e usar o inglês de forma espontânea, sem apoio de materiais, apostilas ou exercícios formais.

As conversas são conduzidas de forma personalizada, respeitando o nível, os interesses e os objetivos de cada aluno. A partir da interação real, o aluno é encorajado a organizar ideias, ampliar vocabulário naturalmente e ganhar fluidez, sempre em um ambiente seguro e acolhedor.

Com base na minha experiência em sala de aula, vivência internacional com o idioma e conhecimentos de psicologia e pedagogia, a aula é guiada para reduzir bloqueios, ansiedade e medo de errar. O objetivo é fortalecer a confiança e tornar o inglês uma ferramenta viva de comunicação.

pro_course_detail.title: English Lessons for Beginners (Common Phrases, Elementary Grammar and Pronunciation)
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are meant for beginner students, be it absolute beginners or students that have very little knowledge. We will be studying elementary grammar, common phrases and pronunciation. The lessons will be a mix of study and practice, depending on the needs of the students. By the end of these lessons, you will be able to express your likes and dislikes, talk about daily events, ask questions about the past and future, and overall be able to communicate basic topics.

These lessons will include things such as:

Ability to pronounce at a baseline level
Pronouns (I, you, him, her etc.)
This, that, these...
Articles (a, an, the)
Singular, plural
Possession (mine, table's...)
Basic verbs (be, walk, eat...)
Basic present and past tenses (I am walking, she ate...)
Negative and question forms
Wants, likes and dislikes
Basic future tenses (I will, you're going to...)
Comparisons (hotter, most complicated...)
Simple conjunctions (so, but, and...)

By the end of these lessons, you will be able to make sentences such as these:

"What did you do last weekend?"
"Yesterday, I went to the park with because the weather was nice."
"I like coffee, but I don't like tea."
"My office is near a big supermarket and it takes twenty minutes to get there."

pro_course_detail.title: English Lessons for Intermediate Students (Conversational Fluency, Complex Grammar, and Vocabulary Expansion)
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are meant for intermediate students, be it those who have recently mastered the basics or students looking to break through a plateau. We will be studying complex grammar structures, expanding vocabulary, and focusing on natural phrasing and connected speech. The lessons will be a mix of studying and practice, depending on the needs of the students. By the end of these lessons, you will be able to clearly express complex opinions, deal with unpredictable travel or work situations, understand the main points of detailed texts, and communicate with a higher degree of fluency and spontaneity.

These lessons will include things such as:

Natural pronunciation and connected speech (linking words, intonation)
Perfect tenses (Present Perfect, Past Perfect, Future Perfect)
Continuous tenses for ongoing or temporary situations
Modal verbs for obligation, deduction, and advice (should have, might be, must)
Conditionals (First, Second, Third, and Mixed)
Passive voice (The report was written...)
Reported speech (He said that he had gone...)
Relative clauses (The man who called yesterday...)
Common phrasal verbs and everyday idioms
Expressing agreement, disagreement, and nuances in opinion
Advanced conjunctions and discourse markers (furthermore, although, whereas...)

By the end of these lessons, you will be able to make sentences such as these:

"If I had known the traffic was going to be this bad, I would have left the house earlier."
"She told me that she had already finished the presentation by the time the manager arrived."
"The new software, which was implemented last month, is supposed to make our workflow much more efficient."
"I've been working on this project since January, and I'm really looking forward to wrapping it up next week."

It is a special language that can be used to communicate with Nigerians and people from English-speaking African countries who do not speak or understand proper English. Any Nigerian that you speak Nigerian pidgin to will feel so happy to hear a language that he/she grew up speaking or hearing.

I am ready to teach you and help you become very fluent in this fun language.

I look forward to our first lesson!

You will please tell me…
1.	Why you are studying English
2.	How long you have been studying English
3.	What goals/benchmarks you want to reach & by when?
4.	Any areas you want to focus on e.g., pronunciation, spelling, grammar vocabulary, or anything else

We can fill the remaining time left (10 minutes) with casual conversation practice about any topic you’re comfortable with.

•	Send my written notes from the session
Hope to see you in our next session.

What sets me apart? I absolutely love teaching kids! Their curiosity and energy inspire me every day. I'm known for being friendly, funny, and super patient—a combo that creates a warm and relaxed learning vibe where students feel free to ask anything without hesitation.
Outside the classroom, I’m always on the move! Whether it’s exploring new places or hitting the court for a game of badminton or basketball, I bring that same energy and excitement into my lessons.

Why Learn with Me?

Fluency doesn’t come from books alone—it comes from practice. And that’s exactly what I offer! We’ll have real conversations, explore fun topics, and I’ll gently correct you on the spot. Step by step, you’ll start building confidence, enhancing your vocabulary, and speaking more fluently.

My Teaching Style

Learning a new language can feel overwhelming—but not with me! I make it simple, enjoyable, and interactive. We’ll work together to make your sentences smoother, your vocabulary stronger, and your speaking skills sharper. I’ll guide you to express yourself with clarity and confidence.

Teaching Materials I Use

PDF Files,Text Documents,Presentation Slides/PPT, udio Files, Images Files, Video Files, Articles and news, Quizzes, Test Templates and examples, Graphs and Charts, Homework and Assignment

Book a lesson and experience it for yourself. Let’s make language learning exciting and fun—together!

pro_course_detail.title: "Say Hello to English!" – Your First Step to Speaking with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description: In this exciting first lesson, students will be introduced to the basics of the English language through simple greetings, self-introductions, and everyday classroom words. his lesson helps learners practice basic greetings, self-introductions, and simple question structures. Through role-playing and guided speaking activities, students gain confidence in initiating and responding to everyday conversations.

Use greetings like “Hello,” “Hi,” and “How are you?”

pro_course_detail.title: Mixed Tenses – Describing Events in the Past, Present, and Future
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, students will practice combining the present simple, present continuous, past simple, and future forms in one conversation. The focus is on switching between tenses as students describe various situations: current activities, routines, past events, and future plans.
Learning Objectives:
Use present simple, present continuous, past simple, and future tenses in context.
Develop fluency in switching between tenses during conversations.
Build confidence in speaking about different time periods in one conversation.

pro_course_detail.title: Pashto Fluency Accelerator 🚀
pro_course_detail.description:
Pashto Fluency Accelerator 🚀

Hey everyone, welcome to the Pashto Fluency Accelerator! This course suits everyone from beginners to the Pushto basics learners aiming to up-skill. Regardless of your level, we will help you throughout the learning journey to ensure proficiency in Pushto.

What You’ll Learn:

Essential Vocabulary 📚: Eliminate the foundation gap by learning everything from greetings to everyday phrases.

Simple Grammar 📝: Understand the clutter-free master rules of sentence structure, tenses, and much more without getting confused.

Pronunciation Tips 🎤: Learn the native way to pronounce words fluently and effortlessly.

Real-Life Conversations 💬: Engage in conversational Pushto during practical scenarios like markets, friend visits, or casual talk.

Cultural Understanding 🌏: You will learn the rich culture and diverse traditions as well because Pashto is more than just a language.

Best Techniques of Learning Quickly:

Embrace the Process Step By Step 🐾: Accept the fact that you cannot tackle everything at once and break tasks into smaller actionable units.

Practice Regularly 🕒: All it takes is about 10-15 minutes each day. That amount of daily input will then get you to fluency much faster!

Listen and Talk Simultaneously 🎧🗣: This can be achieved by listening to Pashto music or watching Pashto series and talking to the speakers themselves.

Make Use of Flashcards 📱: Reinforcement is necessary, hence, try using them for the vocabulary and phrases you have learned.

Consistency is Key 💪: The more you put into practice the more fluent you will become! Remember to stay motivated and not give up.

Make Sure You Complete This Course And You'll End Up Being Able To Read, Write, Speak, And Enjoy Pashto Like A Professional. Get Ready For A Thrilling Ride To Fluency!

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! I’m Abe, a TEFL-certified English tutor with over four years of experience. I specialize in conversational fluency, interview preparation, and immersive learning to boost engagement. I also have experience in the corporate world and project management, helping students develop daily and professional English for real workplace situations. Having lived in Saudi Arabia and the Philippines, I bring a multicultural perspective. I’m a native speaker of English and Tagalog, focused on practical communication. I assess each student through conversation and tailor lessons to improve pronunciation, confidence, and real-world speaking.

I used to teach English at my university, where I worked with foreign exchange students and also had language exchange partners. After that, I decided to pursue my passion for teaching. Along the way, I realized that teaching is a two-way street—you learn just as much from your students as they do from you. I find it incredibly fulfilling to watch my students succeed through their own efforts. I also take great pleasure in breaking down complex ideas in a way that makes them easier to understand. It’s something I truly enjoy.

I like to take things slow at the beginning to assess the student’s level and identify any areas of difficulty through basic conversation. From there, I address the initial concerns and tailor the tutoring to fit the student’s specific needs. I make sure to find out if the student wants to focus on improving a specific topic

It is a special language that can be used to communicate with Nigerians and people from English-speaking African countries who do not speak or understand proper English. Any Nigerian that you speak Nigerian pidgin to will feel so happy to hear a language that he/she grew up speaking or hearing.

I am ready to teach you and help you become very fluent in this fun language.

I look forward to our first lesson!

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday English, Travel English, Business English, General English, Exam Preparation Courses (IELTS, TOEFL, KET, etc.)
pro_course_detail.description:
Everyday English
This course focuses on practical English skills for daily life. Topics include common expressions, conversational phrases, and vocabulary for typical interactions such as shopping, dining, and socializing. The course aims to build confidence and fluency in everyday communication situations.

Travel English
Travel English is designed to help learners communicate effectively while traveling. Topics include vocabulary and phrases for booking flights, checking into hotels, asking for directions, dining out, and emergency situations. The goal is to ensure that learners can navigate travel-related scenarios with ease and confidence.

Business English
Business English focuses on language skills needed in a professional environment. Topics include business correspondence, presentations, negotiations, meetings, and networking. The course also covers industry-specific vocabulary and etiquette to help learners effectively communicate in business settings.

General English
General English provides a comprehensive foundation in English language skills, covering reading, writing, listening, and speaking. These courses are structured to suit all proficiency levels, from beginners to advanced learners. They typically include grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and conversational practice to build overall fluency and comprehension.

Exam Preparation Courses (IELTS, TOEFL, KET)
Preparation courses are designed to help learners succeed in specific English proficiency tests.

teacher_info.intro:
Hey, I’m Joao, a certified teacher with 5+ years of experience teaching English and Portuguese, supported by real-world knowledge in finance, history, travel, culture, business, education, technology, and everyday life.

My specialty? Turning conversations into confidence.

Whether you’re learning for work, travel, or daily life, I’ll help you speak naturally and fluently through engaging, real discussions — not textbook drills.

As a language learner myself, I know how frustrating it can feel when words won’t come. But mistakes aren’t setbacks — they’re stepping stones. In my classes, we laugh, we learn, and we practice until speaking feels effortless, not exhausting.

My approach is simple: you start speaking from day one. The fastest way to learn a language is by using it in real, meaningful conversations. You won’t just listen to explanations — you’ll actively take part in guided discussions, role-plays, and practical scenarios that prepare you for authentic communication.

Over the past five years I’ve helped students from varied backgrounds build confidence to express themselves clearly — in everyday conversations, professional settings, or while traveling abroad.

Let’s embark on this language-learning journey together, where mistakes are part of the process and growth is inevitable.

My goal is straightforward: to help you express yourself with clarity and confidence in any situation.

Ready to turn your words into confidence and sound like a pro? Let’s get started.🚀

pro_course_detail.title: The Fundamentals of Learning the English Language : Phonics Awareness (1 on 1 with tutor)
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is geared toward the beginners of learning the English Alphabet. It's also great for those who are starting to learn the English Alphabet. Phonics is a branch of linguistics where the sounds and physical properties of human speech sounds are studied. This is exactly what this lesson is all about. The Awareness of Alphabet Phonics has three aspects : the image/picture, the name and the sound. Each letter is presented in fun motivational props, named in Upper and Lower Cases and each letter sound is articulated. Phonics reading will help pupils/student to recognize and associate sounds of the letters of the alphabet in the word they read. This will help them to improve in their reading skills and efficiency.

The Tutor will lead the Tutee (Pupil/Student) in a fun and interesting conversation that will encourage the Tutee to speak and use English Language in the Conversation. Along the way the Tutor will help the student with correct word usage, grammar and pronunciation. The goal is to encourage the student to speak in confidence using English Language. This lesson is designed to be highly motivating and fun experience for the student.

The participants are those who are working to boost their level of conversation from Intermediate to Advanced Level or Advanced Level who desire to keep up or  brush up their conversational skills in English Language.
The lesson  includes a wide variety of topics for discussion such Culture and Entertainment, Technology, Economy, Business, Health, Travel Lifestyle, Campus Life work Life, Work, etc. The tutor will lead the group into an intense and fun filled conversation in different ways such as debate, discussion, role play, agree or disagree, making paired or multiple choices, using phrasal verbs and idioms/expressions in the conversation, etc.
Before the lesson ends the tutor will give the evaluation, discuss the outcome of the conversation and provide inputs.The lesson will be specifically designed by the tutor to fit the need of the group.

I’m a native British English speaker, and I help students improve their pronunciation, accent, rhythm, and speaking confidence. My lessons are practical, relaxed, and focused on real conversation — not boring textbook English.

In our lessons, we can work on:

British pronunciation and accent
Clear speaking and natural rhythm
Difficult sounds, stress, and intonation
Reducing strong pronunciation habits from your first language
Speaking more confidently in conversations

I’m a native British English speaker and a qualified financial adviser from the UK. I can help you practise professional English for work, meetings, interviews, presentations, client conversations, and everyday business situations.

In this lesson, we can practise:

Business conversation and workplace English
Finance, banking, insurance, and investment vocabulary
Professional emails and formal communication
Meetings, presentations, and explaining ideas clearly
Job interviews and career-focused speaking practice
Small talk and networking in a professional setting

My lessons are relaxed, practical, and conversation-based. I will correct your mistakes, improve your pronunciation, and help you sound more natural, confident, and professional.

This lesson is perfect if you work in business, finance, sales, customer service, or if you simply want to speak English more confidently in a professional environment.

Book a lesson with me and let’s build your Business English step by step.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation With A British Financial Adviser | Native Tutor
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to feel more confident and prepared for your next job interview in English?

I’m a native British English speaker and a qualified financial adviser from the UK. I can help you practise interview questions, improve your answers, and sound more natural, professional, and confident.

In this lesson, we can work on:

Common interview questions and strong answers
Business, finance, and professional vocabulary
Explaining your experience clearly

Confidence, fluency, and pronunciation

My lessons are relaxed, practical, and focused on real interview performance. I will help you organise your ideas, avoid awkward or unnatural phrases, and speak with more confidence.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello Everyone! My name is Adnan.
I have been teaching Urdu, English, Hindi, and Punjabi for 8 years. I am TEFL-certified, hold a master’s degree, and have taught 20,000+ lessons to students from different backgrounds and levels.
I believe in making lessons creative, dynamic, and engaging to truly bring language to life. My teaching philosophy is built around the idea of “ESID” (Every Student Is Different). I understand that every learner is unique, which is why we will take the time to discuss your individual goals and tailor lessons to suit your needs.
Knowing a language is one thing, but teaching it effectively is another. Before I started teaching online, I dedicated time to studying the best methods for teaching these languages. I carefully developed my own notes using various learning resources to ensure they are clear, structured, and easy to understand.
Instead of asking you to memorize random sentences, I focus on teaching grammar through clear, relatable examples. Every lesson is personalized because I believe no two students learn the same way. We will progress at your pace so that you feel comfortable, confident, and motivated throughout your learning journey.
Whether you are starting from scratch or looking to refine advanced skills, I am here to support you every step of the way.

pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Structure:

My lessons are interactive, engaging, and customized to fit your learning goals. Each session is divided into three parts:

1️⃣ Conversation & Discussion (20 min) – We’ll start with a relaxed discussion on topics that interest you, such as travel, hobbies, current events, or personal experiences. This will help build confidence, expand vocabulary, and improve fluency naturally.

2️⃣ Grammar & Language Focus (20 min) – We’ll dive into essential grammar and language rules in an easy-to-understand way, reinforcing accuracy through practical examples and exercises.

3️⃣ Practice & Activities (20 min) – You’ll apply what you’ve learned through engaging exercises like role-plays, storytelling, real-life scenarios, and writing prompts to strengthen both speaking and writing skills.

🔹 Flexible Learning Option: If your primary goal is to improve speaking skills, we can dedicate the entire lesson to conversation practice, including pronunciation training, fluency-building exercises, and discussion-based learning.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
The objective for each lesson:
1. To learn about the alphabet plus names
2. To learn about numbers 
3.. To learn the articles a, an, and the.
4. To learn English introductions and farewells
5. To learn about people, places, and nationalities and the questions who, what, and where

Teaching method:
I incorporate different kinds of teaching methods in class depending on the needs of the students. These teaching methods are: 
a. direct method - I use this when a student makes a mistake which I immediately correct and praises him/her when she/he makes a correct answer.
b. communicative language teaching - I use this method to enhance the student's ability to speak English by using real-life contexts like making requests, accepting offers, explaining things, and expressing their feelings and preferences.
c. Total Physical Response - I only use this method when needed especially when a student is struggling in understanding a word or a context.

Materials:
I use a variety of materials related to the lesson but there is also an option for the student to use his or her own materials provided it will be sent to me a day before the class so I can prepare for the lesson plan. My materials are not limited to pdf files, PPT, audio, video, images, articles, and so on.

pro_course_detail.title: Structured English Conversation (Personalized)
pro_course_detail.description:
Structured English Conversation (Personalized)
This is a structured, personalized lesson focused on improving your speaking through targeted practice, not free conversation.
Each lesson is built around your specific weaknesses (fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation, confidence, grammar, or expressing ideas clearly).

 How the Lesson Works
Each lesson follows a clear system:
1. Target Focus
 We identify one main area to work on (e.g. past tense, vocabulary gaps, pronunciation, or clarity).
2. Guided Practice
 You practice speaking through:
Topic-based discussions with target vocabulary (real-life or professional topics)
Articles, pictures, or short videos to develop creative thinking, fluency, and idea generation
Structured speaking tasks (storytelling, opinions, debates, problem-solving)
Light grammar focus when needed (e.g. practicing past tense through conversation)
3. Language Correction & Upgrade
I help you correct your mistakes in real time
I help you reformulate your sentences more naturally
I introduce better vocabulary and natural expressions
4. Recap & Next Step
We review your key corrections
We set a clear focus for your next lesson

 What You Will Improve
1.)Fluency and confidence in speaking
2.)Communication skills
3.)Pronunciation and clarity
4.)Vocabulary and natural expressions
5.)Grammar in context (used in conversation, not memorized)
Your ability to express ideas clearly and effectively

📈 Progress & Support
We use a shared document to track:
1.) Corrections
2.) Vocabulary
3.) Lesson notes
4.) Homework (optional)

So you always know:
 what you’re doing
 what to improve
 how to improve

📩 Message me before booking if you plan to study long-term. Please book a trial lesson first so I can understand your goals and create a clear plan.

exp_info.description: As an English language teacher in an international language community in Hanoi, Vietnam, I teach students of all levels, from beginners to advanced. My students come from various nationalities, and I tailor lessons to meet their needs, helping them improve their language skills and achieve greater fluency in English.

With over four (4) years of experience as a community language tutor, I’ve been recognized as a Top 1% English Teacher by italki in 2022. I’m also the most requested Tagalog and Cebuano-Bisaya teacher, serving students from diverse backgrounds, including those in Hong Kong, China, helping them achieve their language goals.

Teaching English to kids, teens, and adults at various levels—beginner, intermediate, and advanced—involves adapting lessons to suit individual needs. Beginners focus on basic vocabulary and grammar, while intermediate learners work on sentence structure and communication skills. Advanced students refine their fluency and writing, ensuring effective and confident language use.

teacher_info.intro: Hello! I’m Alex, a Cambridge-certified English tutor from the UK, and I’m truly passionate about languages and communication. As a native English speaker, I’ve completed several English language studies and earned qualifications that give me a strong understanding of my own language. Whether you’re a Romanian, Russian, or Spanish speaker—or simply someone who loves learning languages like I do—I’m here to support you every step of the way as you master English. If you’re worried about pronunciation, need help with grammar, or just want to have a friendly chat to practice your conversation skills in a relaxed, encouraging and stress free environment, I’m always happy to help. I know that learning a new language can be challenging, but I believe that with the right guidance and encouragement, anyone can become confident in English. I also know British Sign Language and enjoy sharing it with curious learners. My background in language studies means I understand the difficulties you might face, and I’m committed to being a supportive and enthusiastic educator. My lessons and materials are always 100% personalised to the learner. I can adapt easily to different learning styles. If you’re looking for a friendly, knowledgeable teacher who can connect with you in several languages and help you build your confidence, I’d love to work with you. Please feel free to book a lesson with me—I’m excited to join you on your language learning journey!

----What we will do in each lesson---
1. Read together: 
We will start by reading a short article (5-10 minutes). The topic will be something you are interested in, like technology, travel, or art. This makes learning more fun!
2. Practice pronunciation:
 While we read, we will work on the sounds of new words. You will learn how to say them more clearly and naturally.
3. Have a conversation: 
After we read, we will talk about the article. This is your chance to use the new words you learned and share your ideas. We will have a good conversation, and this will help you speak more easily and with more confidence.

This lesson package helps you with the most important skills for real-life conversations. You will learn new words and feel more confident to speak with others!

Whether you're struggling with vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, or just not knowing how to respond in the moment, we’ll work together to uncover exactly what's standing in your way.

pro_course_detail.title: What would say

In our lessons, I’ll provide clear context to help you understand how certain words or phrases are used in real situations. If something feels unfamiliar or confusing, I’ll suggest useful alternatives, break down difficult expressions into simple terms, and explain how and when to use them.

Whether it’s understanding subtle word differences, using natural sentence patterns, or building a stronger vocabulary, I’ll guide you through the process with patience, encouragement, and clarity.

You're not expected to be perfect—you’re expected to try. And I’ll be right here to make sure that effort leads to real progress.

teacher_info.teaching_style: I aim to teach and share three languages: English, Tagalog, and Cebuano. My lessons will start with basic words and progress to phrases and other areas of learning based on the student's interests. To achieve this, I implement the three D’s teaching style: 1. Directing, 2. Discussing, and 3. Delegating. First, Directing involves telling students what to do, how to do it, and what needs to be done. Second, Discussing encourages teacher-student interaction by asking questions and listening actively. Finally, Delegating assigns tasks for students to work on independently. Effective teachers use a variety of styles and know when and how to apply them.

pro_course_detail.title: TCF and TEF PREPARATION: Mastering Oral Expression and All Core Exam Components
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for the TCF or TEF for Canadian immigration, French citizenship, or university admission? Don't leave your Oral Expression score to chance.

This specialized lesson is designed for students who need more than just "conversation"—you need strategy, structure, and high-level performance to impress the examiners and hit your target CLB level.

### Targeted Oral Expression Training
I provide intensive training for the specific tasks required by each exam:

TCF Preparation (Tasks 1, 2, & 3):

Task 1: Master the spontaneous exchange.

Task 2: Learn how to ask the right questions to gather information effectively.

Task 3: Structure your arguments clearly to express opinions on complex topics.

TEF Preparation (Tasks 1 & 2):

Section A: Perfect your information-gathering through formal and informal roleplay.

Section B: Master the art of persuasion and argumentation to convince your interlocutor.

### A Comprehensive Approach to Success
While we focus on the speaking component, I provide a holistic approach to ensure you are ready for every part of the exam:

Full Exam Support: Beyond Oral Expression, I can assist you with Oral Comprehension, Written Expression, and Reading Comprehension. I will guide you through the logic of the entire exam so there are no surprises on test day.

Exclusive Resource Library: My students gain access to a vast collection of preparation materials, including past exam topics, specialized vocabulary lists, audio samples, and structural templates that you can use to "plug and play" your answers.

Official Criteria: We practice based on the specific grading rubrics used by examiners: fluency, vocabulary range, and grammatical precision.

Mock Exams: Experience a simulated exam environment with a timer and professional feedback to eliminate "stage fright."

"Don't just practice until you get it right. Practice until you can't get it wrong." Book your session today, and let’s start working with the best materials and strategies.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice for Spouse, Family, or Travel to Bangladesh or India
pro_course_detail.description:
Pearls of wisdom are to be found in the texts written by the famous writers, eminent poets, great philosophers, and religious masters from Bengal. The fictional Bengali books written by Rabindranath Tagore, Vidyasagar, Bankim Chandra, Sarat Chandra, Satyajit Ray, Sukumar Ray, and Jibanananda Das will be discussed. Besides, MYTHOLOGIES like Ramayana, Mahabharata, Bhagavat Geeta, CHILDREN’S BOOKS like Panchatantra, Roopkathar Golpo, Betal, Thakumar Jhuli, Tuntunir Golpo, Gopal Bhnar, and DETECTIVE BOOKS like Feluda, Byomkesh, and Kakababu will be used for Bengali verbal communication. The stellar works of Swami Vivekananda will be discussed with interested students. Bangla audio and video references will be used to learn accent and pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: Discussion on Spirituality, Religions, Meditations, and Pilgrimage Sites in India
pro_course_detail.description:
India, often called the land of spirituality, has been the birthplace of profound philosophies, ancient wisdom, and diverse religious traditions. This course is designed to explore the rich spiritual heritage of the subcontinent.  

What This Course Covers -

1. Understanding Indian Religions
   - A deep dive into Hinduism, Buddhism, and other Indian spiritual traditions 
   - Core beliefs, practices, and philosophical aspects of these religions  
   - The evolution of these traditions and their influence on global spirituality  

2. Spirituality and Indian Philosophical Systems 
   - Discussions on Advaita Vedanta, Sankhya, and other schools of thought in Sanatana Dharma  
   - The different branches of Buddhist philosophy, including Theravāda, Mahāyāna, and Vajrayāna  
   - How these philosophies shape self-realization, consciousness, and enlightenment  

3. Meditation and Spiritual Practices 
   - Various meditation techniques, including mindfulness (Vipassana), mantra meditation, and yogic practices  
   - How spirituality and meditation contribute to inner peace and self-awareness  
   - The role of asceticism, devotion, and self-discipline in spiritual growth  

4. Sacred Texts and Wisdom Literature
   - Exploration of the Bhagavad Gita, The Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna, Dṛg Dṛśya Viveka, and other key scriptures 
   - Interpretations of ancient teachings in modern life  
   - The relevance of these spiritual texts in contemporary spirituality  

5. Pilgrimage and Sacred Destinations
   - A guide to India’s renowned temples, monasteries, and sacred sites 
   - Spiritual significance and historical background of destinations like Varanasi, Bodh Gaya, Rishikesh, and Nalanda

pro_course_detail.description:
I prepare you for your International English exam like IELTS or TOEFL, FCE, CPE, PET, etc. My students generally have a 100% pass rate, provided that they do their homework, practice daily, and give themselves enough time to prepare.

I have helped quite a few students reach their required band score! One student increased his speaking band score by 2 levels! They are now able to study and work abroad. Another teenage student went from A1 - C1 in about 3 years!

You don't need to know the dictionary to reach your required band score! The speaking test requires everyday English, no need for fancy or complex words or phrases. Getting a band score of 7 or above could change your life forever! For this, you will need to use the English language creatively, using complex grammatical structures and various vocabulary. 
Having helped many IELTS students, I understand the pressure and struggles that IELTS students go through to reach their required band scores. These are predominantly students who are struggling to achieve a band 7 score either because of the speaking or writing part. The IELTS exam is life-changing in many ways and I would love to help you achieve your dreams. These customized lessons will help you reach your required band score.  

I will identify the areas where you are struggling and create an effective plan to correct those mistakes. I will be offering you some tips and strategies to make sure that you are ready to ace your exam! You will feel empowered to face the exam head-on. The student will also be able to pay more attention to their areas of weakness while improving their areas of strength. 

Your progress will be measurable. As part of your continual learning, I also send short videos or audio on request, that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! I’m Abe, a TEFL-certified English tutor with over four years of experience. I specialize in conversational fluency, interview preparation, and immersive learning to boost engagement. I also have experience in the corporate world and project management, helping students develop daily and professional English for real workplace situations. Having lived in Saudi Arabia and the Philippines, I bring a multicultural perspective. I’m a native speaker of English and Tagalog, focused on practical communication. I assess each student through conversation and tailor lessons to improve pronunciation, confidence, and real-world speaking.

I used to teach English at my university, where I worked with foreign exchange students and also had language exchange partners. After that, I decided to pursue my passion for teaching. Along the way, I realized that teaching is a two-way street—you learn just as much from your students as they do from you. I find it incredibly fulfilling to watch my students succeed through their own efforts. I also take great pleasure in breaking down complex ideas in a way that makes them easier to understand. It’s something I truly enjoy.

I like to take things slow at the beginning to assess the student’s level and identify any areas of difficulty through basic conversation. From there, I address the initial concerns and tailor the tutoring to fit the student’s specific needs. I make sure to find out if the student wants to focus on improving a specific topic

teacher_info.about_teacher: The way I see language learning is a bit philosophical but it also came from my personal experience after being both a student and a teacher for a while. I envision the process of language learning to be similar to the process of growing a tree; you need patience and take care of the plant on a regular basis to get a result that normally can not be pushed ahead of time...But you can always add-in some fertilizers (which are in my case a certain set of technics) to get improved results in terms of time and quality.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Lessons: I prefer that you book packages to show commitment and also to get along with the nature of the process ( as I explained earlier: expect to practice on a regular basis ! ), I am very flexible and I don't have a problem canceling or reporting lessons... I can also use instant messaging apps like Whatsapp if you feel like learning and practicing on the go. 
Let's talk technics: I am not a big fan of the Pimsleur method unless it's used with some other tools to remember the vocabulary you learned. For example, Anki flashcards. I prefer to rely on the spaced repetition system proposed by apps like Duolingo and Memrise.

teaching_experience.description: I started teaching here in Italki in 2017 and It's been a long fulfilling journey so far. My biggest achievement is that when I see a student commit to learning for a couple of years and each time make it to a higher level!

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Sandra (SAN-druh), a certified ESL teacher with 4 years of experience. I help students move past boring textbooks to find genuine fluency. Whether you are a professional, a student, or a parent, I am here to make English your strongest asset.

Why Choose My Classroom?
I focus on natural conversation and practical results rather than grammar drills:

Business English: Navigate the corporate world with ease. We will polish your emails, master meetings, and build confidence for presentations.

Test Prep (IELTS/TOEIC): Get the scores you need with targeted strategies and practical exercises.

Lessons for Kids: I use fun, interactive activities to build speaking and reading skills engagingly.

Travel and Culture: Learn the English you need for daily life using real-world stories and pop culture.

My Method
Every lesson is tailored to your goals. I use real materials like articles and podcasts to ensure you learn the language people actually use today. I prioritize conversation to build your confidence while keeping your skills balanced.

I create a comfortable environment where it is safe to make mistakes—that is how we grow. My goal is to make you feel capable and empowered.

pro_course_detail.title: Legal English
pro_course_detail.description:
This Legal English Course provides targeted training to enhance your understanding and use of the "lingua legalis" (legal language).
Here’s a breakdown of key topics and skills that can be taught:

1. Legal Vocabulary
Terminology: Learn essential legal terms and phrases used in various areas of law (e.g., contract law, criminal law, corporate law).
Idiomatic Expressions: Understand common idioms and phrases that are frequently used in legal contexts.

2. Legal Writing Skills
Drafting Documents: Techniques for writing contracts, briefs, memos, and letters.
Legal Analysis: Learn how to analyze and summarize legal texts clearly and concisely.
Citation Formats: Familiarization with proper citation styles.

3. Oral Communication
Presentations: Skills for presenting legal arguments effectively.
Negotiation Techniques: Strategies for negotiating contracts and settlements.
Courtroom Skills: Practice for speaking in court, including direct examination and cross-examination.

4. Reading Comprehension
Case Law Analysis: Techniques for reading and interpreting case law and legal opinions.
Statutory Interpretation: Understanding how to read and analyze statutes and regulations.

5. Practical Applications
Mock Trials: Participate in simulated trials to apply your skills in a real-world context.
Role-Playing Exercises: Engage in role-playing scenarios to practice negotiation and client interaction.

6. Cultural Aspects of Law
Legal Systems: Overview of different legal systems (common law vs. civil law) and their terminology.

Knowing the role that each word has in a sentence structure clearly helps to understand sentences and also  to construct them properly. -Intonation and rhythm to help you sound more natural

course_info.trial_description:
The trial lesson is a relaxed 30-minute session designed for us to get to know each other and make sure we’re a good fit.

During the trial lesson, we will:
- Talk about your goals, needs, and learning style
- Do a short level check through conversation or simple activities (student specific)
- Identify your strengths and areas to improve
- Discuss a clear learning plan moving forward

This lesson is pressure-free and supportive ,there are no expectations to be perfect. It’s simply a chance to feel comfortable, ask questions, and see how lessons will work.
By the end of the trial, you’ll have a clear idea of what to expect and how we can work together to reach your goals

pro_course_detail.description:
I offer engaging, supportive English lessons where children and teens build confidence while learning naturally.

Lessons focus on:
- Vocabulary, pronunciation, and speaking confidence.
- Learning colours, numbers, shapes, and age-appropriate topics.

My goal is for learners to enjoy English while developing strong communication skills they can use at school and beyond.

pro_course_detail.title: Daily English Free talking
pro_course_detail.description:
To enhance your speaking ability with the help of Daily activity topics.

Here's a more detailed breakdown:
1. Active Listening:
Pay close attention: Focus on what the other person is saying, both verbally and nonverbally. 
Show you're listening: Nod, make eye contact, and use verbal cues like "uh-huh" or "I see". 
Ask clarifying questions: Demonstrate you're engaged by asking questions to understand their perspective. 
Reflect and paraphrase: Summarize what you've heard to ensure understanding and show you're paying attention. 
2. Engaging Questions:
Ask open-ended questions: Encourage detailed responses instead of just "yes" or "no" answers. 
Follow up on answers: Show genuine interest by asking more questions based on their responses. 
Find common ground: Look for shared interests or experiences to build rapport and keep the conversation flowing. 
Avoid leading questions: Don't steer the conversation towards your own opinions or experiences. 
3. Body Language and Tone:
Maintain eye contact: It shows you're engaged and interested in the conversation. 
Use open body language: Avoid crossing your arms or looking down, as these can signal disinterest. 
Speak clearly and at a comfortable pace: Avoid mumbling or speaking too quickly, which can make it difficult to follow. 
Be mindful of your tone: A positive and friendly tone can make conversations more enjoyable.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS, TOEIC, FCE,TOEFL (test preparation)
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is a process of equipping your  skills, strategies, and confidence needed to perform well in an English language test. It involves understanding the test format, practicing key language skills, and developing effective techniques to manage time and reduce stress during the exam.

This preparation typically focuses on the following areas:

Reading: Enhancing comprehension skills, such as skimming, scanning, and understanding context.
Writing: Practicing essay writing, letter writing, or other text types while focusing on grammar, structure, and clarity.
Listening: Improving the ability to understand spoken English through audio exercises and active listening.
Speaking: Building confidence in oral communication by practicing fluency, pronunciation, and clear expression.
Test preparation may also include mock exams, timed practice sessions, and personalized feedback to help learners identify their strengths and areas for improvement. By combining skill development with test-taking strategies,you are better equipped to approach the test with confidence and achieve their desired results.

pro_course_detail.title: job interview preparation (business english )
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to help you communicate effectively and confidently in professional settings. It focuses on developing the language skills needed for the workplace, including speaking, writing, listening, and reading in a business context.

You will learn how to:

Participate in meetings, interviews, and presentations

Write professional emails, reports, and proposals

Use polite and formal language in business communication

Handle phone calls and video conferences effectively

Expand your vocabulary for business, management, and office settings

Each lesson includes practical role-plays, vocabulary building, and feedback to help you sound more natural and professional in English.

pro_course_detail.title: The Fundamentals of Learning the English Language : Phonics Awareness (1 on 1 with tutor)
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is geared toward the beginners of learning the English Alphabet. It's also great for those who are starting to learn the English Alphabet. Phonics is a branch of linguistics where the sounds and physical properties of human speech sounds are studied. This is exactly what this lesson is all about. The Awareness of Alphabet Phonics has three aspects : the image/picture, the name and the sound. Each letter is presented in fun motivational props, named in Upper and Lower Cases and each letter sound is articulated. Phonics reading will help pupils/student to recognize and associate sounds of the letters of the alphabet in the word they read. This will help them to improve in their reading skills and efficiency.

pro_course_detail.title: Pashto For Relationship OR family
pro_course_detail.description:
​Unlock the heart of the Pashto language by learning how to navigate the complex and beautiful world of Pukhtun family life. In this lesson, we go beyond simple vocabulary to explore the deep-rooted traditions, respect, and social etiquette that define Pashto-speaking communities.
​What You Will Learn
​This lesson is designed to give you the cultural and linguistic tools to speak like a native within a family setting:
​The Core Family (Koraanai)
Master the essential terms for your immediate circle. We will cover the specific Pashto words for father (Plar), mother (Mor), brother (Ror), and sister (Khor), along with the respectful suffixes used in daily life.
​Paternal & Maternal Lineage
Pashto has unique titles for relatives on different sides of the family. You will learn the difference between your father's brother (Tra) and your mother's brother (Mama), as well as the specific terms for their wives and children (Azeezan).
​The Concept of "Ghairat" and "Izzat"
Understand the cultural values of honor and respect. I will teach you the polite forms of address (Mashar vs. Kashar) and how to properly greet elders and guests in a traditional Pashto environment.
​Conversational Scenarios
Practice real-life conversations: how to introduce your family, how to ask about someone’s well-being (Khaireyat), and the specific idioms used during family gatherings and weddings.
​Why Book This Lesson?
​Native Insights: As a native speaker from the heart of the Pashto-speaking region (Kohat), I provide the most authentic pronunciation and regional nuances.
​Cultural Context: I don’t just teach you the words; I explain the "why" behind Pukhtun social structures.
​Customized Learning: Whether you are marrying into a Pashto family, working in the region, or reconnecting with your roots, I tailor the vocabulary to your specific needs.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Tagalog Language in 30 Days – Conversational Practice for Travelers (Kids & Adults)
pro_course_detail.description:
This intensive 30-day beginner-friendly program is designed for travelers who want to quickly learn practical Tagalog for real-life communication in the Philippines. Whether for vacation, family visits, volunteering, or cultural immersion, learners will build essential speaking and listening skills through simple, structured, and interactive lessons.

The course focuses on everyday conversational Tagalog, helping students confidently handle common travel situations such as greetings, asking for directions, ordering food, shopping, transportation, hotel stays, and basic social interactions. Lessons are designed to be fun, engaging, and easy to follow, making it suitable for both kids and adults with no prior experience.

Each day includes:

Practical vocabulary for real travel situations
Simple grammar explanations (no heavy theory)
Dialogue practice and role-playing activities
Listening exercises using native-style conversations
Pronunciation guidance for clear communication
Cultural tips to help learners interact respectfully and naturally

pro_course_detail.title: English Expressways Reading and Language for Beginner Elementary
pro_course_detail.description:
English Expressways: Reading and Language (Grade 1) is a learning material or approach designed to help young learners develop basic English communication and literacy skills in a fun, interactive way. It combines reading, speaking, and language activities suitable for early elementary pupils.

📘 Description

The English Expressways (Grade 1)program focuses on guiding learners through a “journey” of learning English, where they practice different skills step by step. It uses stories, pictures, and activities to make learning meaningful and enjoyable.

 🧩 Key Features

*1. Reading Skills Development

* Pupils read short and simple texts with pictures.
* They learn to understand stories by identifying:

  * Characters, setting, and events
  * Main idea and details
* They practice retelling stories and answering questions. 

*2. Phonics and Word Recognition

* Focus on letter sounds and how letters form words.
* Includes rhyming words, blending sounds, and recognizing common sight words. ([K5 Learning][2])

*3. Vocabulary Building

* Introduces simple words related to:

  * Family, school, and everyday life
* Helps learners understand meanings using pictures and context. 

*4. Grammar and Language Use

* Teaches basic sentence structure (simple sentences).
* Introduces:

  * Nouns (names of people, places, things)
  * Action words and describing words
* Uses correct capitalization and punctuation. ([K5 Learning]

*5. Speaking and Listening

* Encourages students to:

  * Talk about themselves and their experiences
  * Use polite expressions (e.g., greetings, thank you, sorry)
* Develops confidence in communicating in English. 

*6. Interactive Learning Approach

* Uses:
  * Role-playing
  * Group activities
  * Songs, rhymes, and discussions
* Promotes active participation and critical thinking.

pro_course_detail.title: Let’s Learn Tagalog Verbs for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
In this beginner-friendly Tagalog lesson, you will learn how to use common Tagalog verbs in everyday conversations. The lesson introduces basic action words, simple sentence patterns, and essential verb forms used in daily life. You’ll practice speaking about routines, actions, and activities such as eating, going, studying, and working.

By the end of the lesson, learners will be able to:

* Identify common Tagalog verbs
* Use verbs in simple present, past, and future forms
* Create basic Tagalog sentences
* Understand how verb focus works in beginner-level conversations
* Improve pronunciation and confidence in speaking Tagalog

This lesson is designed for absolute beginners and includes easy examples, pronunciation guides, and practical exercises to help learners build a strong foundation in Tagalog grammar and communication skills.

pro_course_detail.title: Brazilian Portuguese for Beginners | Start Speaking from Your First Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to my Brazilian Portuguese course for complete beginners!

Have you always wanted to learn Portuguese but didn’t know where to start? This course is the perfect introduction to the language spoken by more than 200 million people in Brazil.

In our lessons, you will learn Portuguese from scratch in a clear, structured, and enjoyable way. We will focus on pronunciation, essential vocabulary, useful grammar, and real-life conversations so that you can start speaking from the very first class.

I look forward to meeting you and helping you discover the beauty of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture!

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons and teaching styles varies from student to student because  every student is unique. 
One strategy might work with a beginner but it might not be applicable to my next student who happens to be a beginner as well. So, I usually do a quick assessment for the first 30 seconds of interaction with my student.  After doing the assessment I then move forward with methodologies I have adopted through my teaching experience both as a classroom teacher and ESL tutor. Teaching style is like a concoction of recipes that you could adjust based on what every learner needs.

teacher_info.intro:

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a fun, relaxed, and engaging way to practice your English? Do you want to improve your fluency, gain confidence, and speak more naturally? If so, regardless of your English level, my "Free English Conversation" lesson is perfect for you!

**What is this lesson about?**

This is a free conversation lesson where you can practice speaking English in a comfortable and supportive environment on any topic you like. Sometimes, we may use materials like videos or articles to spark real, meaningful conversations that help you express yourself better.

**How will this lesson help you?**

By joining my Free English Conversation lesson, you will:
✅ Improve your fluency and pronunciation
✅ Learn new words and phrases in a natural way
✅ Gain confidence in speaking English
✅ Develop better listening skills
✅ Learn about different cultures and perspectives
✅ Get personalized feedback and tips to improve your speaking

**How to Prepare for the Lesson**

You don’t need to prepare anything! Just bring yourself, a willingness to talk, and maybe a cup of coffee or tea. However, if you have a topic in mind, feel free to share it with me before our lesson.

**Final Words**

Speaking English fluently is not about memorizing grammar rules—it’s about practice! The more you speak, the more confident you’ll become.

Let’s have an engaging conversation and take your English to the next level!

See you! 😊
